jobs.title: Lead Design Engineer HIP
jobs.description:
About Bodycote

At Bodycote, we’re more than the world’s leading provider of heat treatment and specialist thermal processing services. We’re a people business at heart. Our commitment to innovation and sustainability shapes everything we do. With a global footprint and a culture built on collaboration, curiosity, and continuous improvement, we create an environment where you can grow, contribute, and make a meaningful impact. Sustainability is central to our future. We’re on an ambitious journey to reduce our environmental impact through advanced technologies, smarter processes, and ongoing innovation, with our teams around the world playing a key role in making that happen.

The Role

As Lead Design Engineer you will act as the senior technical authority, directing design, supplier management, delivery, commissioning and lifecycle support activities for design/make of global Bodycote HIP hot zone systems. Leading the design engineering team entails directing project management from concept to internal customer handover, and ensuring high-quality, consistent outputs on time and within budget. In addition, you will ensure alignment of design with business goals and become a specialist in holistic HIP system behaviour. You report to Head of Engineering, HIP Europe.

The key responsibilities will include, but are not limited to the following:

    

Mentoring and directing team members & conducting performance reviews etc.

    

Implementing structure & best practices in design functional management

    

Define & select appropriate design tool sets, and embed standards/guidelines

    

Ensure design data is correctly configuration controlled & managed using PLM principles

    

Managing projects, setting priorities, and ensuring work aligns with timelines, budgets and product performance expectations.

    

Working with Operations, Maintenance and Engineering teams to align designs with business goals and documenting design decisions appropriately

    

Ensure solutions are technically & economically feasible, meeting safety/legal standards

    

Travel to HIP sites when needed to support production delivery, problem solving and improvement, and visit suppliers as necessary

Who We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone who brings:

    

Strong experience of the engineering design process & disciplines over several years

    

Ability to read, write, and speak English and Swedish

    

Degree in mechanical design engineering or equivalent experience

    

Experience working with complex mechanical components & assemblies

    

Proficiency in 3D CAD, design data control, finite element analysis systems etc.

    

Good team player with collaborative attitude and a flexible approach

    

Self-motivated, organised and able to work under pressure to a schedule

    

Good problem solving skills, receptive to different viewpoints

Advantageous characteristics:

    

Team leadership

    

Experience of SOLIDWORKS

    

Experience working with heat treatment, gas handling, & complex tooling

    

Understanding of gas behaviour, heat & mass transfer

    

Experience of design & risk reduction techniques like DFMEA

What’s In It for You

    

Career progression opportunities within a global organisation

    

Exposure to international projects and change initiatives

    

A supportive, inclusive culture where your development matters

    

The opportunity to help shape the next chapter of our business

    

Competitive salary and benefits package

Location & Work Pattern

This role is a full time, permanent position based in Surahammar, with hybrid expectations. Some travel is required depending on business needs.

Ready to Apply?

If you’re ready to join Bodycote and make a real impact, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and start your journey with us.

We are an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Palvelupäällikkö (sähkö ja turva), Oulu
jobs.description:
Haluatko olla mukana varmistamassa, että asiakkaidemme kiinteistöt toimivat luotettavasti ja turvallisesti joka päivä? Jos sähkötekniikka on vahvuutesi ja innostut ihmisten, asiakkaiden ja kokonaisuuksien johtamisesta, saatat olla etsimämme palvelupäällikkö. Haemme kiinteistöpalveluihimme sähköalan palvelupäällikköä vakituiseen työsuhteeseen.



Palvelupäällikkönä pääset yhdistämään teknisen osaamisen, esihenkilötyön ja asiakkuuksien kehittämisen. Vastaat asiakkuuksiemme sähkö- ja turvatekniikan huoltotöiden työnjohdosta sekä tarjouslaskennasta. Arki on monipuolista: johdat sekä tuntiperusteisia pientöitä että laajempia projektikokonaisuuksia. Toimit asentajien lähiesihenkilönä, tuet tiimisi onnistumista ja varmistat, että työt etenevät sujuvasti, laadukkaasti ja asiakaslähtöisesti. Lisäksi kehität asiakkuuksia ja tunnistat mahdollisuuksia kasvattaa yhteistyötä.

Kiinteistöpalveluissamme työsi näkyy asiakkaidemme arjessa konkreettisella tavalla. Huolehdimme muun muassa kauppakeskusten, hotellien ja toimistokiinteistöjen taloteknisestä huollosta ja kunnossapidosta. Tavoitteenamme on varmistaa kiinteistöjen toimintavarmuus, energiatehokkuus ja hyvät olosuhteet käyttäjille.

Voit olla etsimämme osaaja, jos sinulla on:

- tehtävään soveltuva tekninen koulutus, esimerkiksi sähköinsinöörin tai -teknikon tutkinto

- vähintään kahden vuoden kokemus vastaavista tehtävistä

- S1- tai S2-sähköpätevyys tai valmius hankkia pätevyys

- kokemusta tarjouslaskennasta

- kokemusta esihenkilötyöstä tai ihmisten johtamisesta

- kokemusta paloturvallisuushuolloista, mikä katsotaan eduksi

Tässä tehtävässä onnistut, jos

olet tavoitteellinen, yhteistyökykyinen ja kannustava esihenkilö, joka vie asioita eteenpäin yhdessä tiimin kanssa. Työskentelet itsenäisesti, suunnittelet tekemisesi huolellisesti ja pidät kokonaisuudet hallinnassa myös muuttuvissa tilanteissa. Arvostat hyvää asiakaspalvelua ja haluat rakentaa pitkäjänteisiä, luottamukseen perustuvia asiakassuhteita.

Kiinnostuitko? Lähetä hakemuksesi viimeistään 13.9.2026. Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana ja täytämme tehtävän sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa toimialapäällikkö Marko Karttunen, puh. 040 300 5510 tai sähköpostitse marko.karttunen@are.fi.


Tarjoamme


- Virike- ja hierontaedun

- Laajan työterveyshuollon

- Kattavan vapaa-ajan tapaturmavakuutuksen

- Lounasedun

- Mahdollisuuksia lisäkouluttautumiseen (mm. oppisopimus, verkkokurssit)

- Omaehtoisen opiskelun tuen


Meillä pääset osaksi perheomisteista yritystä, jossa työtä tehdään vastuullisesti, reilusti ja yhdessä onnistuen. Saat tueksesi osaavan tiimin ja esihenkilön sekä mahdollisuuden työskennellä mielenkiintoisissa asiakaskohteissa. Tarjoamme vaihtelevia työpäiviä, mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa omaan työhösi sekä tukea ammatilliseen kehittymiseen ja uusien urapolkujen rakentamiseen.


ARE

ARE on suomalainen perheyritys, jolla on yli sadan vuoden kokemus talotekniikasta. Tarjoamme ratkaisuja ja palveluita kiinteistön koko elinkaarelle uudiskohteiden talotekniikkaurakoinnista, ylläpitoon ja huoltoon, huollosta modernisointiin ja korjausrakentamiseen. Tahdomme olla talotekniikan suunnannäyttäjä ja siksi kehitämme toimintaamme jatkuvasti. Työskentelemme tiiviisti yhdessä asiakkaidemme kanssa löytääksemme parhaat ratkaisut, oli kyseessä sitten toimisto, hotelli, sairaala tai teollisuuslaitos. Tavoitteena on aina energiatehokkaat tilat ja tilojen käyttäjille miellyttävät sisäolosuhteet, kustannustehokkaasti toteutettuina.



Puhelin: 020 530 5500 Sähköposti: hr@are.fi Sijainti: Elektroniikkatie 3-5 1C West, 90590 Oulu

jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Why Doktor.se

Doktor.se is Sweden's largest digital healthcare provider. We combine physical clinics with a digital platform serving millions of consultations per year across Sweden, Germany, and Norway. Our 25-person engineering team has startup autonomy inside a profitable, international organization with 1,000+ employees and over 1B SEK in revenue.

We run OpenAI and Anthropic models in production across patient and clinician workflows, and that footprint is growing fast.

What you'll do

Our infrastructure works, but it was built to solve yesterday's problems. We need someone who can help us get to where we want to be — not maintain what we have, but reshape it. If you want a place where everything is already figured out, this isn't it. If you want to build something better, here's what you'd own:

    

Build a deployment platform where teams ship their own services without asking you for permission.

    

Design infrastructure that is secure by default, so teams don't have to think about encryption, network isolation, or data residency. It just works.

    

Create deployment pipelines where security scanning, policy checks, and compliance happen automatically, invisible when everything is fine, loud when something needs attention.

    

Support and scale infrastructure for AI workloads, we run models in production across our platform, and that footprint is growing.

    

Set up observability that gives teams real insight into their own services, useful dashboards, alerts that mean something, not noise that everyone ignores.

    

Work closely with developers to understand what slows them down, and then fix it. Not by doing it for them, but by making it easy for them to do it themselves.

    

Maintain and evolve our cloud account structure, networking, and identity management across multiple regions and products.

Some weeks you'll write infrastructure code. Some weeks you'll pair with a developer to debug a slow service. Some weeks you'll design how a new product gets its own isolated infrastructure. The common thread: you make the teams around you better.

Make developers faster, not more dependent on you.

What we're looking for

    

You've built and operated Kubernetes in production. Not just deployed a Helm chart once, you've debugged networking issues, designed RBAC policies, and thought about how multiple teams share a cluster without stepping on each other.

    

You know AWS well. Accounts, networking, IAM, KMS. You have opinions about what should live in Kubernetes and what genuinely needs to be an AWS managed service, and you lean toward keeping things in Kubernetes where possible.

    

You've worked with GitOps and infrastructure as code. Flux, ArgoCD, Terrafor, specific tools matter less than the principle: infrastructure changes go through pull requests, are reviewed, and are auditable.

    

You understand developers because you are one. You can read their code, understand their pipelines, and have meaningful conversations about architecture.

    

You think about security as something you design into systems, not something you review at the end.

    

You have opinions, and you can change them when someone makes a better argument.

    

University degree in computer science, engineering, or equivalent experience.

Tech stack

Cloud - AWS (multi-account, multi-region)

Orchestration - Kubernetes / EKS

IaC - Terraform

CI/CD - GitHub Actions

Languages - Python, TypeScript

AI - OpenAI, Anthropic (in production and tooling)

Observability - Datadog / Grafana (you'll shape this)

What we offer

    

Real influence. You'll shape how our platform works, not just operate what someone else designed.

    

Healthcare context. Patient data, regulatory compliance, and real consequences for getting it wrong. What you build actually matters.

    

Small team, direct impact. 25 engineers, your work is visible, not lost in a machine.

    

Autonomy. No micromanagement, no endless approval chains.

    

AI in production. We're running LLMs in patient and clinician workflows today, the infrastructure needs to grow with that.

    

Collective agreement, 30 days vacation, wellness allowance, personal development budget.

Practical details

    

Start: As soon as we find the right person. We'll accommodate your notice period.

    

Employment: Permanent, full-time. Six month probation period.

    

Location: On-site, Monday–Thursday at Sveavägen 63, Stockholm. Fridays are flexible.

    

Language: English is our working language in tech. Swedish is a bonus.

    

Work permit: You must already have the right to work in Sweden.

    

Contact: Andrew Crookston, VP of Engineering

We handle recruitment internally — no agencies, no consultants, no external recruiters.

jobs.title: Project Manager - Medium Voltage Switchgear
jobs.description:
På ABB hjälper vi industrier att bli mer resurseffektiva och renare – och varje person här bidrar till resultaten. Du kommer att få möjlighet att leda, få stöd att växa och kunna vara stolt över den påverkan vi skapar tillsammans. Gå med oss och hjälp till att driva det som driver världen.

Denna position rapporterar till:

Project Operations Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will take full ownership of customer projects within medium-voltage switchgear solutions, leading deliveries from order to completion. You will act as the key point of contact for customers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders, ensuring successful project execution while building strong and long-term relationships.

We are looking for a driven and technically minded project manager who enjoys taking responsibility, solving challenges, and creating value for customers. Whether your background is in project management, engineering, design, installation, or service, your technical understanding and ability to drive projects successfully are what matter most.

This role is contributing to the Electrification Distribution Solutions (ELDS) business in Sweden.

You will be mainly accountable for:

    Leading and coordinating project activities throughout the entire project lifecycle.
    Managing project scope, schedule, changes, costs, and quality to achieve project objectives.
    Collaborating closely with customers and our factories and suppliers to ensure effective communication and successful project delivery.
    Acting as the primary point of contact for customers and building long-term, trust-based relationships throughout the project lifecycle.
    Ensuring project documentation, reporting, and compliance with internal processes and customer requirements.
    Participating in Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) and coordinating related activities with internal and external stakeholders.
    Driving continuous improvement initiatives and contributing to efficient project execution within the team.

Our team dynamics

You will join a collaborative and knowledgeable team where teamwork, technical expertise, and customer focus are key success factors. We support each other, share knowledge, and work together to deliver high-quality solutions to our customers.

Qualifications for the role

    You have experience leading technical projects and taking ownership of project execution from customer order to final delivery.
    Experience within medium-voltage systems, switchgear solutions, power distribution, or related electrical infrastructure is highly valued.
    You possess a strong technical understanding, gained either through project management roles or hands-on experience as an engineer, designer, technician, installer, service engineer, or similar technical positions.
    You have experience working closely with customers, suppliers, and multiple stakeholders, and you are comfortable building trust-based relationships.
    Experience working in SAP is required.
    You are fluent in Swedish and English, both written and spoken.
    A degree in engineering, project management, or another relevant technical field is considered a merit but is not a requirement.

You are a relationship builder who enjoys collaborating with customers, suppliers, and colleagues across different functions. With your strong communication skills, you create trust, provide clarity, and adapt your approach to different audiences and situations. You work in a structured and organized way, enabling you to prioritize effectively, manage multiple activities simultaneously, and maintain focus even in complex project environments. You thrive in a dynamic setting where priorities can shift, and you remain solution-oriented and proactive when facing challenges or tight deadlines. As a person, you are driven, take ownership of your work, and are comfortable making decisions that move projects forward.

What We Offer

At ABB, we believe that our people are our greatest asset. We offer:

    An inclusive and collaborative workplace where you can grow both personally and professionally.
    The opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology that helps shape a more sustainable future.
    Flexible working arrangements, including the option to work remotely.
    A comprehensive benefits package designed to support your wellbeing and work-life balance.
    Occupational pension, insurance coverage, and enhanced parental leave benefits.
    A wellness allowance per year and access to occupational health services.
    Continuous learning opportunities and support for your professional development.

More about us

At ABB Electrification Distribution Solutions (ELDS), we help customers ensure a reliable and sustainable supply of electricity to industries, infrastructure, and communities. Our solutions play a key role in the energy transition by enabling safe and efficient distribution of electrical power.

In Sweden, we deliver medium-voltage switchgear solutions to customers across a wide range of industries, supporting projects from design and manufacturing through installation and commissioning. Our project teams work closely with customers, suppliers, and ABB factories around the world to deliver solutions that keep critical operations running.

Join us and become part of a business that combines technical expertise and customer focus to shape the future of energy distribution.

Recruiting Manager: Vendela Egondotter, +46 70 380 70 11, will answer your questions about the position. Union representatives – Sveriges Ingenjörer: Linda Nyman, +46 70 233 30 88, Unionen: Johan Lundström, +46 703 52 00 56, Ledarna: Lenny Larsson, +46 706 32 85 47. Talent Partner: Medina Jakupovic, +46 72 464 46 98, will answer your questions about the recruitment process.

We look forward to reading your application in PDF-format. Last day to apply is 20 September. We review applications on an ongoing basis, which means that the position may be filled before the application deadline.

We kindly request no direct contact from staffing or recruitment agencies, or vendors offering additional job advertising services.

Contribute to a shared vision. This is where ideas become reality, progress is made, and we shape the world together. Run what Runs the World.

We value people from diverse backgrounds. Could this be your next step? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about us and see how our technology is making an impact on the world.

jobs.title: Lähihoitaja
jobs.description:
**Etsimme alihankintakumppania kotihoitoon**

Haluatko yrityksesi kanssa aidosti vaikuttaa ihmisten hyvinvointiin ja tehdä jokaisesta työpäivästä merkityksellisen? Tule mukaan kotihoitoon osaksi lämminhenkistä ja ammattitaitoista verkostoamme, jossa arvostetaan osaamistasi, itsenäistä työotettasi ja halua kohdata ihmiset yksilöinä.

**Tehtävä**

Alihankintana toteutettavassa kotihoidon lähihoitajan työssä tuet asiakkaidemme turvallista ja hyvää arkea heidän omissa kodeissaan. Työ on monipuolista, vastuullista ja vaihtelevaa, eikä yksikään päivä ole samanlainen. Tehtäviin kuuluvat muun muassa:

- asiakkaiden kokonaisvaltainen hoito ja päivittäisissä toiminnoissa avustaminen

- lääkehoidon toteuttaminen ja voinnin seuranta

- toimintakyvyn ylläpitäminen ja kuntouttavan työotteen hyödyntäminen

- asiakkaiden, omaisten ja moniammatillisen tiimin kanssa tehtävä yhteistyö

- hoidon suunnittelu, arviointi ja kirjaaminen


**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**

Toivomme, että olet lähihoitaja tai edustat lähihoitajan pätevyyden omaavaa yritystä, jolla on aito halu kohdata ihmiset arvostavasti ja tarjota laadukasta hoitoa. Toimit vastuullisesti ja oma-aloitteisesti sekä työskentelet luontevasti itsenäisesti. Hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot, positiivinen asenne ja joustavuus auttavat sinua onnistumaan yhteistyössä kanssamme. Edellytämme voimassa olevaa Y-tunnusta ja tarvittavia vakuutuksia.

**Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?**

Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden käyttää ammattitaitoasi monipuolisesti ja kehittyä jatkuvasti yhteistyössä kanssamme. Et jää yksin, sillä tukenasi on osaava ja välittävä verkosto. Meiltä saat:

- merkityksellisen toimeksiannon asiakkaiden hyvinvoinnin edistämiseksi

- kattavan perehdytyksen ja tuen yhteistyön alkuun

- monipuoliset ja vaihtelevat toimeksiannot

- mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi

- kannustavan, avoimen ja arvostavan yhteistyöilmapiirin

- mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa omaan työhösi ja hyödyntää vahvuuksiasi


Jos haluat tehdä yhteistyötä, jossa kohtaamisilla on merkitystä ja jokainen toimeksianto tarjoaa mahdollisuuden auttaa, kuulemme sinusta mielellämme. Tule mukaan rakentamaan turvallista ja laadukasta kotihoitoa. Yhdessä teemme asiakkaidemme arjesta parempaa.

jobs.title: Master Thesis Project  Material Characterization
jobs.description:
Seco in Fagersta is offering a master thesis project within the R&D Materials and Technology Department, focusing on material characterization of cemented carbide cutting tools for high-performance machining applications.

Background  

Composite materials composed of a hard ceramic phase-traditionally tungsten carbide-and a ductile binder phase, typically cobalt, are commonly referred to as hard materials or cemented carbides. These materials are produced using a powder metallurgy process that includes wet milling, spray drying, compaction, and sintering.

Cemented carbides offer an attractive combination of high hardness and toughness. By adjusting grain size and binder content, their properties can be tailored to meet specific application needs.

With a strong focus on sustainability and circularity, the production and use of recycled cemented carbides contribute to reducing environmental impact and improving resource efficiency.

Work description  

In this project, you investigate plastic deformation in cemented carbide cutting inserts, with a particular focus on how deformation varies across the cutting edge region. Previous studies show that plastic deformation is highly heterogeneous and strongly dependent on the specific location analyzed. This variability highlights the need for large-area characterization to obtain representative and reliable results.

The project involves advanced microstructural characterization using Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM) over large, stitched areas. A central focus is to systematically map and analyse deformation across extended regions beneath the cutting edge, rather than relying on small, localized observations.

You apply Electron Backscatter Diffraction (EBSD) to quantify local plastic deformation through Kernel Average Misorientation (KAM) analysis, providing insights into local strain and dislocation density. In addition, SEM image analysis is used to identify and evaluate deformation-related features such as binder redistribution, shear band formation, and microstructural heterogeneity.

Overall, the project aims to enhance the understanding of how plastic deformation develops in cutting tools and how it can be reliably quantified using large-area SEM and EBSD-based techniques. The work is also closely connected to the ongoing European project AIM-NEXT, which focuses on the design and implementation of non-CRM hard materials for next-generation extreme applications. (https://www.aimnext.eu/)

Your background  

We’re looking for a highly motivated student in Materials Science or a related field. A curious mindset, a structured approach to work, and the ability to independently carry out laboratory tasks after initial training are essential. Prior laboratory experience is considered an advantage, as is familiarity with SEM.

As part of the thesis, you present your results both orally and in a written report in English, making strong English communication skills essential.

Duration of the project  

The thesis project runs for 20 weeks, with a flexible start date that is agreed upon with the student. On-site presence in Fagersta is required, although some work may be carried out remotely by agreement. Accommodation is provided, and the project includes a one-time compensation.

Our Seco culture  

At Seco, we're united by a spirit of collaboration and a shared curiosity to learn and grow. We take responsibility for our actions, stay focused on our customers, and believe in winning together. For us, it’s also clear that our diversities form an amazing foundation for achieving great results. Curious about our workplace and benefits? Read more on our website. You’re also welcome to visit our LinkedIn or Facebook to get to know us and our products further.

Contact information

jobs.title: Master Thesis Project  Material Science
jobs.description:
Seco in Fagersta is offering a master’s thesis project within the R&D Materials Development group, focusing on the sintering kinetics of recycled cemented carbide. The project combines materials science, sintering behavior, and material properties related to the sintering process.

We offer a great workplace with access to state-of-the-art R&D facilities and collaboration with a top-tier research team. You gain valuable experience in materials science, including Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM) and Electron Backscatter Detector (EBSD) and various materials characterization techniques.

Background and scope of the project

Circularity in the carbide industry is essential for reducing CO₂ emissions and lowering costs due to the limited resources of tungsten and cobalt. This project explores how increasing the proportion of recycled cemented carbide powder impacts the sintering process. Today, recycling worn-out carbide tools is well established, with cemented carbide powders containing up to 50–100% recycled material depending on grade and availability.

Work description:

    Conduct sintering experiments in lab scale furnace
    Measuring:
    Magnetic properties (related WC grain size and carbon balance)
    Dimension (shrinkage control quality related)
    Hardness of the sintered cemented carbide (Standard Vickers method)
    Toughness of the cemented carbide (crack resistance by Palmqvist method)
    SEM analysis of structure (WC grain size EBSD)
    Analysis of results
    Thesis writing

The experimental factors are set up with the statistical method Design of Experiments (DOE) in collaboration with the supervisor at Seco. Conducted at the Fagersta production site, the study is experimental including analysis and supported by both the R&D team and production technicians. 

Your profile  

We’re looking for a curious and technology driven MSc student with a focus on material science or material chemistry. Knowledge in metallurgy, physics, mechanical engineering, and similar skills are valuable. Previous experience with SEM and EBSD is advantageous, along with analytical and mathematical skills. Acting in an international environment, good English skills are essential.

Duration of the project

This thesis project lasts for 22 weeks with a flexible start date, preferably around January 19th, 2027. We offer you accommodation in Fagersta and you receive payment when finalizing the thesis. You’ll also present your findings both written and verbally.  

Our Seco culture

For us, it’s also clear that our diversities form an amazing foundation for achieving great results. Curious about our workplace and benefits? Read more on our website. You’re also welcome to visit our LinkedIn or Facebook to get to know us and our products further.

jobs.title: Cabin Crew Member Helsinki Base, Finnair
jobs.description:
Finnair is a diverse community of professionals who work ambitiously with a big heart and commitment. A strong safety culture is our priority and at the core of our everyday work, never taking it for granted. We are committed to doing our share in solving the climate challenge by determinedly following our science-based pathway to decarbonize our operations. We find meaning in our purpose: With our heart in Finland, we make every journey better, today and tomorrow. Our values - Always Safe, Customer at Heart and Stronger Together - guide us in everything we do.

Finnair Cabin Crew recruitment for 2027 is now open! Are you ready to be part of the Finnair team where the sky isn't the limit? We offer both permanent and fixed-term full-time employment opportunities. Join us as cabin crew member and discover a career that's always uplifting. Your journey to the skies starts here!

As a cabin crew member, you are responsible for ensuring cabin safety and delivering excellent customer service on Finnair flights. Being a part of Finnair cabin crew means that you provide the best possible experience and meaningful encounters for our customers.

What we are looking for and what we expect from you:

- Positive attitude and excellent customer service skills
- Excellent teamwork skills in a diverse environment
- Sales-oriented mindset and good communication skills
- Ability to work according to procedures and guidelines
- Resilience, persistence, and ability to adapt to changing situations

What is required to become a Cabin Crew Member at Finnair?

- Age of at least 18 years old
- Secondary education completed (upper secondary/vocational school)
- Fluency in English
- Fluency in Finnish is highly valued (additional languages are an advantage)
- Height minimum 160 cm and ability to reach 218 cm barefoot
- At least 1 year of experience in hospitality or customer service
- Good general health and the ability to work irregular hours and night shifts, including coping with stress related to circadian disruption. Minimum requirement EASA Part Med Cabin Crew and Finnair regulations.
- Normal colour vision and normal hearing, distant visual acuity using both eyes 0.7 or better (with or without corrective lenses)
- Ability to swim 40 meters
- When wearing a uniform, all visible tattoos must be fully covered, and all visible piercings must be removed (excl. earrings)
- Clean criminal record
- Valid EU, EEA or Swiss passport allowing free worldwide travel
- Eligible to live and work permanently in Finland and arrive to Helsinki Airport within one hour when on stand-by

Working at Finnair:

We offer you an exciting opportunity to work in the fast-changing aviation and international travel industry in a culture that drives and enables professional development and continuous improvement. You will be supported by internally highly rated supervisory work with modern leadership practices that we constantly develop.

We are happy to enable our employees to enrich their lives and fulfil their travel dreams by offering a wideleisuretravel benefit. We also support the health and wellbeing of our employees through our own Sickness Fund insurance benefit,Epassi(sport, culture, wellbeing or commuting benefit), gyms around the Finnair campus and activities organized by our hobby clubs.

Before employment, selected candidates will participate in a non-paid training course of 6-9 weeks. 100% on-site attendance at our training facilities in Vantaa is required. Successfully passed cabin crew training is a prerequisite for employment. Training is unpaid and begins gradually in the beginning of 2027.

Please note that the hiring process includes a pre-employment security clearance and a medical examination, including a drug test.

To make sure you have all the details you need about the recruitment process, training, health requirements and more, please take a moment to visit: https://www.barona.fi/tyopaikat/finnair/

Fasten your seatbelt and apply now but no later than 6.9.2026 23:59 EET. Submit your application through the official application form, as we are unable to consider applications sent by email due to data protection reasons. The employment contract is made with Finnair, and Barona is the recruitment partner in the process. If you have any further questions, please contact finnair@barona.fi.

Our people are key to our success and the foundation that makes Finnair unique. We are committed to creating a safe work environment where all our people can thrive and succeed.We cherish diversity and strive to employ people with different backgrounds and experiences, to bring together multiple views to foster our business success.According to our employee survey, respecting diversity is at a high level in our work community. You are welcome to join Finnair as your authentic self.

To apply for open positions, youll need to create a job seeker profile in Barona Careers. You only need to fill in your profile once, and after that, you can apply to any Barona job using the same profile. Based on your work experience, educational background, and skills, well recommend jobs that suit you best. Barona Careers makes job searching easier than ever!

jobs.title: CSRD Reporting Expert, (Project Manager)
jobs.description:
Tokmannin halvat hinnat tuottavat iloa ja hyötyä, sekä helpottavat asiakkaan elämää. Työskentelemme yhdessä tämän tavoitteen puolesta ja tarjoamme asiakkaillemme halvan hinnan lisäksi myös sujuvan ja nopean asioinnin myymälöissämme sekä laajan ja vastuullisesti hankitun ja tuotetun tuotevalikoiman. Tokmanni Group Oyj on yksi Pohjoismaiden johtavista halpakauppakonserneista. Onnistuneen asiakaskokemuksen takaamiseksi työskentelemme yli 6000 työntekijän voimin yhteensä yli 370:ssä Tokmanni-, Dollarstore-, Bigdollar-, Miny-, Click Shoes- ja Shoe House -myymälässämme sekä verkkokaupoissamme. Vuonna 2023 Tokmanni-konsernin liikevaihto oli 1 392,7 miljoonaa euroa ja vertailukelpoinen liikevoitto 98,8 miljoonaa euroa. Tokmanni Group Oyj:n osakkeet on listattu Nasdaq Helsingin pörssilistalle. Meille tokmannilaisille on tärkeää, että toimimme vastuullisesti ja tehokkaasti ympäristöstä ja ihmisistä välittäen. Kannustamme sekä autamme henkilöstöämme kehittämään osaamistaan ja panostamme hyvään yhteishenkeen. Avaamme jatkuvasti uusia myymälöitä ja rekrytoimme uusia osaajia. Etsimme joukkoomme erilaisilla osaamistaustoilla varustettuja henkilöitä monenlaisiin työtehtäviin. www.tokmanni.fi https://tyopaikat.tokmanni.fi/

Would you like to play a key role in shaping and delivering sustainability reporting in a leading Nordic retail group? We are looking for an experienced CSRD Reporting Expert to lead our CSRD reporting and reporting development projects. Position is in Tokmanni Group's Sustainability team and for a one-year parental leave replacement.

In this role, you will be responsible for coordinating and delivering Tokmanni Group's CSRD reporting and supporting the continuous development of reporting processes and practices. The position plays a key role in ensuring high-quality sustainability disclosures and compliance with evolving reporting requirements.

While the title includes project management responsibilities, we are primarily looking for a hands-on sustainability reporting professional. You have personally worked on CSRD reporting, collected and validated sustainability data, interpreted reporting requirements, and written report content. We are primarily looking for candidates who have hands-on experience preparing CSRD reports for listed companies, either in-house or in a consulting role. Success in this role requires both project leadership skills in cross company network and extensive hands-on experience in sustainability reporting, combined with deep practical expertise in the European Sustainability Reporting Standards (ESRS) and their application in corporate reporting.



Your key responsibilities

- Lead the planning, coordination, and execution of Tokmanni Group's CSRD reporting process
- Collect, analyze, validate, and manage sustainability-related data across the organization
- Prepare and develop sustainability report content in line with ESRS requirements
- Interpret sustainability reporting regulations and translate regulatory requirements into practical reporting actions
- Support the update and further development of the Group's Double Materiality Assessment
- Develop reporting processes, data management practices, and reporting tools
- Produce and review reporting materials in both Finnish and English
- Coordinate and review translations between Finnish and English to ensure consistency and quality
- Work closely with stakeholders across sustainability, finance, HR, procurement, legal, marketing, business operations, and external assurance providers.



What we expect from you

- Hands-on experience preparing CSRD reporting in a listed company or as a consultant supporting listed companies
- Proven track record in sustainability data collection, data management and drafting CSRD-compliant sustainability report content
- Deep and comprehensive expertise in the ESRS standards and demonstrated ability to apply them in practice within CSRD reporting
- Strong understanding of the sustainability reporting regulatory landscape and reporting frameworks
- Excellent written communication skills and experience drafting reporting content
- Fluency in both Finnish and English, with the ability to translate and adapt content between the two languages. Proficiency in Swedish is considered an asset.
- Strong analytical skills and exceptional attention to detail
- A structured, self-driven, and solution-oriented way of working
- Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills, with the ability to drive progress without formal authority. - Ability to start working as soon as possible.

We also value experience in double materiality assessments, reporting system development, and knowledge of the retail or consumer goods industry.



What we offer

We offer you a unique opportunity to work at the heart of sustainability reporting in one of Finland's leading retail groups. You will have a visible and impactful role, working with a broad range of stakeholders and contributing to the development of Tokmanni Group's sustainability reporting and reporting capabilities.

You will join a friendly and supportive team where collaboration is valued and success is achieved together. We offer a flexible hybrid working model that combines office and remote working, enabling both effective teamwork and focused individual work.

In addition, we provide a competitive package of employee benefits, including ePassi, staff discounts, and a wide range of partner benefits.



Application instructions and further information

The position is a fixed-term parental leave replacement for one year. The position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate is found. The weekly working hours are 37.5 h/week. The primary workplace is Tokmanni Group's Head Office in Mäntsälä, Finland, and the role follows the Group's hybrid working model. Occasional travel within the Group may be required.

Please submit your application, CV, and salary expectation as soon as possible or at the latest on August 28th. We will review applications during the application period and fill the position immediately once the right candidate is found.

Further information will be given by Kaisa Matsson, Group Head of Sustainability tel. 040 6734948 or by email kaisa.mattson@tokmanni.fi. Please call on Wednesday Aug 19th 9-12 and Friday Aug 21st 10-13.

Miksi sinä ja me?

Sinua arvostetaan – todellisena itsenäsi. Wärtsilässä SINÄ olet tärkeä. Arvostamme monimuotoisuutta ja olemme sitoutuneet tukemaan osallistavaa työyhteisöä.

Saat vaikuttaa. Innovaatio ja kestävä kehitys ovat meille tärkeitä. Joka päivä me, Wärtsiläläiset, panemme sydämemme ja mielemme mahdollistamaan kestävien yhteiskuntien toteutumisen teknologian ja palveluiden innovaatioiden kautta.

jobs.title: Vi søger betonchauffør til Unicon i Slagelse eller Holbæk
jobs.description:
Vil du køre nogle af Danmarks mest ikoniske lastbiler og være med til at levere fundamentet for fremtidens byggeri?

Hos Unicon søger vi en betonchauffør til vores fabrik i Slagelse eller Holbæk. Som betonchauffør hos os er du meget mere end chauffør. Du er en vigtig del af støbningen og den, der sikrer, at betonen kommer sikkert frem, i den rette kvalitet og på det rigtige tidspunkt.

Du trives naturligvis bag rattet i en stor bil, men mindst lige så vigtigt er det, at du kan samarbejde med kollegerne på fabrikken og med kunderne på byggepladserne. Alle dage afsluttes på fabrikken, så du slipper for overnatninger i bilen.


Du bliver en vigtig del af byggepladsen

Som betonchauffør hos Unicon kører du betonen fra fabrikken til byggepladsen, hvor du samarbejder med både kunden, pumpechaufføren og kollegerne om at få støbningen til at forløbe som planlagt.

Du leverer ikke bare et produkt – du er med til at sikre, at byggeriet kan fortsætte.

Nogle leverancer losses direkte fra bilens bånd, mens andre overføres til en betonpumpe. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du kan samarbejde med de mennesker, der modtager betonen, og bidrage til, at arbejdet udføres sikkert og effektivt.

Du kommer til at navigere på byggepladser, hvor pladsen ofte er trang, og hvor præcision og overblik er afgørende. Det kræver gode køreevner, sikkerhedsfokus og evnen til at holde hovedet koldt, når forholdene er udfordrende.


Mere byggeplads end landevej

Hvis du drømmer om lange ture gennem Europa, er dette nok ikke det rette job.

Som betonchauffør hos Unicon kører du typisk mange korte ture mellem fabrikken og lokale byggepladser. Til gengæld bliver du en del af byggeprojekterne og får en hverdag med tæt kontakt til kunder, kolleger og samarbejdspartnere.

Det er et job for dig, der kan lide variation, ansvar og en arbejdsdag, hvor du gør en synlig forskel.


Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har stort kørekort inkl. hænger/trailer (CE)

  • Har EU-bevis

  • Har fokus på din egen og andres sikkerhed

  • Trives med at køre og manøvrere store køretøjer under krævende forhold

  • Er serviceminded og professionel i mødet med kunderne

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine leverancer

  • Har fysik til rengøring og vedligeholdelse af bilen

  • Holder orden omkring dig og dit materiel

Det er en fordel, hvis du har krancertifikat eller erfaring fra bygge-, entreprenør- eller transportbranchen, men det er ikke et krav.


Derfor skal du vælge Unicon

Hos Unicon bliver du en del af Danmarks førende betonproducent og et stærkt fagligt fællesskab, hvor sikkerhed, kvalitet og samarbejde går hånd i hånd.

Vi tilbyder:

  • Branchens bedste ansættelsesforhold

  • Grundig oplæring og introduktion til jobbet

  • Moderne materiel og gode arbejdsforhold

  • Betalt arbejdstøjsordning inklusive vask

  • Gode udviklingsmuligheder – både fagligt og personligt

  • En unik holdånd og stærkt kollegialt fællesskab

  • Overenskomst gennem Dansk Industri og 3F

  • En hverdag med selvstændighed og ansvar

En arbejdsdag, hvor kunderne er med til at sætte dagsordenen

Som betonchauffør er din arbejdsdag styret af byggepladsernes behov og dagens leverancer.

Du får typisk besked om mødetid den følgende dag om eftermiddagen, når næste dags produktion og leverancer er planlagt. Arbejdsdagen slutter, når den sidste tur er kørt og bilen er vasket. Du kommer derfor hjem hver dag og slipper for overnatninger i bilen. Derfor er det ikke et traditionelt 7-15-job, og nogle dage kan blive kortere end forventet, mens andre dage bliver længere. Overarbejde forekommer jævnligt, men bliver naturligvis honoreret, og vi har gode muligheder for både udbetaling og opsparing af afspadsering, som mange af vores chauffører bruger til hele fridage.

Hvis du trives med variation, ansvar og en hverdag, hvor opgaven bliver gjort færdig, vil du passe godt ind hos os.


Sådan bliver du en del af holdet

Med udgangspunkt fra vores fabrik i Slagelse eller Holbæk bliver du en del af et stærkt team af chauffører og kolleger, som hver dag arbejder sammen om at levere beton til nogle af områdets vigtigste byggeprojekter.

Du refererer til fabrikkens daglige leder.

Kan du se dig selv i rollen, hører vi gerne fra dig.

Send din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte områdechef Jacob Christensen på telefon 23626202.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi finder den rette kandidat.

 

Om Unicon 

Unicon Danmark tilbyder lige muligheder for alle og har aktivt fokus på at fremme et arbejdsmiljø, der er fri for diskrimination, og hvor medarbejdere behandles med værdighed og respekt. I vores virksomhed er ansættelse baseret på den enkeltes fortjenester og kvalifikationer, som er direkte relateret til kompetencekrav i jobbet. Vi diskriminerer ikke nogen medarbejder eller jobansøger baseret på race, etnicitet, nationalitet, herkomst, genetiske oplysninger, statsborgerskab, religion, alder, køn, kønsidentitet/udtryk, seksuel orientering, graviditet, civilstand, handicap eller andre beskyttede karakteristika efter gældende love eller regler. Vi overholder disse principper i alle aspekter af ansættelse, herunder rekruttering, ansættelse, uddannelse, kompensation, forfremmelse og fordele.

jobs.title: Senior Tax Specialist / Tax Manager – Gothenburg
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced Tax Specialist / Tax Manager for an assignment with an international organization in Gothenburg.

The role is part of the Group Tax function and involves responsibility for global tax processes, with a particular focus on Pillar II reporting, as well as tax compliance, planning, and strategy for selected legal entities. You will work closely with internal stakeholders, external advisors, auditors, and tax authorities.

Key Responsibilities

    

Lead and coordinate the Group’s Pillar II reporting

    

Develop and implement global tax strategies to optimize the effective tax rate

    

Provide tax advice related to cross-border transactions, M&A, and restructurings

    

Identify tax optimization opportunities while ensuring alignment with business objectives

    

Manage direct tax filings and payments, ensuring timely compliance

    

Manage tax audits and inquiries from tax authorities

    

Review current and deferred tax calculations

    

Review tax provisions under local GAAP for selected legal entities

    

Monitor developments in local and international tax legislation and support implementation of relevant changes

    

Maintain robust internal controls to mitigate direct tax risks

    

Collaborate with external tax advisors and auditors to ensure accurate tax reporting

Your Background

We are looking for a tax professional with a strong combination of technical expertise, analytical ability, and business understanding. You should have:

    

A university degree in Law, Finance, or a related field

    

Minimum 8 years of relevant professional experience within tax

    

Good understanding of finance processes and systems

    

Strong knowledge of international taxation, US tax legislation, and tax accounting standards

    

Strong analytical, communication, and project management skills

    

Strong business acumen and a high level of integrity

You are self-motivated, proactive, and solution-oriented, with the ability to identify improvements and take ownership of complex issues. You are also comfortable working in a fast-paced international environment and communicating effectively with multiple stakeholders.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced tax professional who wants to take on a key role in global tax reporting, compliance, and strategic tax matters within a complex international organization.

jobs.title: Hoitaja sympaattiselle asiakkaalle Raaseporiin
jobs.description:
Hoiva-avustaja sympaattiselle seniorille

Haemme hoiva-avustajaa osa-aikaiseen työhön avustamaan sympaattista senioriasiakastamme Raaseporissa. Etsimme myös hoitajaa avustamaan muita asiakkaitamme.

Haluaisitko tehdä hoiva-avustajan työtä osa-aikaisesti, kiireettömästi ja ilman sairaanhoidollisia työtehtäviä sympaattisten ikäihmisten kanssa? Saatat olet tuleva hoitaja-helpperimme! Olit sitten opiskelija, kerryttänyt jo kokemusta hoiva-avustajana tai etsit muuten vain osa-aikatyötä, tässä roolissa ratkaisee innokkuus ja aito halu auttaa suurella sydämellä!

Me olemme Hemby, ikääntyneiden palveluita rohkeasti uudistava yritys, joka tarjoaa iloa ja turvaa ikäihmisten arkeen. Mottomme on: autamme ikääntyviä kuin omaa äitiämme.

Kasvamme jatkuvasti ja etsimme lisää hoiva-avustajan koulutuksen omaavia helppereitä tiimiimme. Löydät lyhyen ja helposti täytettävän hakulomakkeemme täältä: https://helpper.hemby.fi/apply

Mitä hoitaja-helpperi tekee?

Hoitaja-helpperi on sosiaali- ja terveysalan koulutettu henkilö, joka tarjoaa arjen apua ja seuraa omalle nimetylle ikäihmiselle. Hoitaja-helpperi tukee ikäihmistä kaikenlaisissa arjen askareissa, kuten ulkoilu ja kauppareissut, kodin ylläpito, ruokailussa tukeminen, saattoapu, yhdessäolo ja jutustelu.

Hoitaja-helpperi tukee seniorin hyvinvointia kokonaisvaltaisesti. Hoivan ja huolenpidon tehtävät sisältävät:

suihkuapua voinnin tarkkailua kotona pärjäämisen tukemista liikkumisessa tukemista

Lisäksi voit auttaa asiakasta suihkussa ja henkilökohtaisessa hygieniassa. Työtehtäviin ei kuitenkaan kuulu sairaanhoidollisten palveluiden toteutusta, kuten lääkehoitoa.

Mitä hoitaja-helpperin työ vaatii?

Sitä, että palat halusta auttaa ikäihmisiä. Lisäksi hoitaja-helpperin työ vaatii sosiaali- ja terveysalan tai hoiva-avustajan koulutuksen tai vankan kokemuksen hoiva-avustajan työstä.

Tärkeintä on, että haluat viettää aikaa ikäihmisten kanssa ja tehdä omalla toiminnallasi heidän arjestaan parempaa. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat hyvin joustavat.

Mikä on parasta hoitaja-helpperin työssä?

Kysyimme tätä hoitaja-helppereiltämme, ja näin he vastasivat:

"Ihmisten kiireetön kohtaaminen ja ystävystyminen seniorin kanssa."

"Toisen auttaminen ja merkityksellisyyden tunne."

Auttaminen kokonaisvaltaisesti seniorin tarpeiden mukaan."

Hoitaja-helpperinä saat:

Oman nimetyn ikäihmisen, jota autat arjen askareissa ja olet hänelle seurana Joustavat työajat, jotka sopivat mainiosti esimerkiksi opiskelun ohelle tai lisätyöksi. Tavallisin työaika on 2-10h/vko. Kilpailukykyisen palkan: 15,29-17,29 €/h + työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät sekä lomakorvaukset. Hyvät etenemismahdollisuudet: Voit edetä kokemuksen ja hyvän asiakaspalautteen ansiosta pro- tai guru-helpperiksi ja saada korotusta palkkaasi!

Hakemukset lähetetään sähköisen lomakkeen kautta. Olemme kaikkiin hakijoihin yhteydessä hakemuksen lähettämisen jälkeen.

Lähetä hakemus hoitaja-helpperiksi täällä.

Lue lisää Hembystä klikkaamalla tästä.

Mikäli sinulla on kysyttävää hoitaja-helpperiksi ryhtymisestä, laita meille sähköpostia osoitteeseen rekry@hemby.fi, niin jutellaan lisää!

jobs.description:
Notre client est un groupe hôtelier à taille humaine, multi-enseignes, exploitant plusieurs établissements sous franchises Accor et Louvre Hotels Group en France.
Nous recherchons pour un de leur établissement situé en région lyonnaise, leur futur :

Directeur d'hôtel H/F
CDI - Statut Cadre
Basé à Lyon
Plus de 150 chambres - Hôtellerie économique
Encadrement d'une 20aine de personnes

Vos motivations :
Vous souhaitez relever un véritable challenge de direction au sein d'un actif hôtelier à fort potentiel. Vous appréciez les environnements où tout reste à construire, où votre impact est visible et où les résultats dépendent directement de votre capacité à mobiliser les équipes et à mettre en œuvre des actions concrètes.
Vous aimez les postes terrain, avec une forte dimension opérationnelle, commerciale et managériale. Vous recherchez une structure à taille humaine vous laissant une réelle autonomie dans vos décisions tout en bénéficiant du soutien d'un groupe solide.

Vos missions :
Rattaché à la Direction des Exploitations, votre mission principale consiste à redonner une dynamique de performance à cet actif stratégique du groupe en activant l'ensemble des leviers opérationnels, commerciaux et humains.
- Développement commercial : définir et piloter le plan d'action commercial, développer les partenariats locaux, renforcer la visibilité de l'établissement, optimiser le mix clientèle et contribuer à l'amélioration durable du chiffre d'affaires.
- Revenue management et performance : En relation avec le revenue manager du groupe, suivre les indicateurs clés de performance (taux d'occupation, prix moyen, RevPAR, GOP), analyser les résultats, identifier les axes d'amélioration et mettre en œuvre les actions correctives nécessaires.
- Management : recruter, encadrer, accompagner et fédérer les équipes autour d'objectifs communs. Développer une culture de la performance, de l'engagement et de la satisfaction client.
- Exploitation : garantir le bon fonctionnement quotidien, veiller au respect des standards de marque, assurer la qualité de service et maintenir un haut niveau de satisfaction client.
- Gestion sociale : accompagner les évolutions organisationnelles du site et assurer un dialogue social constructif dans un contexte d'internalisation récente des équipes de ménage.
- Pilotage économique : élaborer et suivre les budgets, optimiser les charges d'exploitation et garantir la rentabilité des établissements.

Votre profil :
Issu d'une formation en hôtellerie, tourisme ou gestion, vous justifiez d'une expérience significative en direction d'hôtel ou en direction adjointe au sein d'établissements à forte capacité.
- Vous êtes reconnu pour votre forte orientation résultats et votre capacité à développer l'activité commerciale d'un établissement. Véritable manager de terrain, vous savez mobiliser les équipes, accompagner le changement et créer une dynamique positive dans des contextes exigeants.
- Doté d'une excellente culture opérationnelle, vous maîtrisez les enjeux de rentabilité, de revenue management et de satisfaction client. Vous faites preuve d'autonomie, de leadership et d'une forte capacité d'analyse.

jobs.title: Lead Architectural Project Manager - Data Centres (Arkitema)
jobs.description:
Data centres play a vital role in society, and the decisions made today will shape the digital and sustainable infrastructure of tomorrow. At Arkitema, we are intensifying our focus on data centres and strengthening our capabilities to support clients in delivering the next generation of digital infrastructure.



Therefore, we are looking for a Lead Architectural Project Manager to join us. In this role, you will work closely with clients, colleagues, and partners to shape and deliver data centre projects from early concept through to design and implementation. From day one, you will engage directly with clients - leading meetings, guiding decision-making, and driving the delivery of CSA disciplines across projects. You will translate global concepts into locally compliant solutions while structuring teams and workflows to ensure efficient execution.

Arkitema was established in 1969 making us one of Denmark's oldest architectural firms. Today, we are well positioned in Scandinavia with offices in Denmark, Norway and Sweden.

In our markets we provide wide range of competencies in our areas of expertise. We cover sectors and disciplines like healthcare, industry, transformation, landscape and residential construction.

Since 2019 Arkitema has been part of COWI, one of Scandinavia’s leading engineering and consultancy companies. Together with customers, partners and colleagues, we shape a future where people and societies grow and flourish. We do that by co-creating more sustainable and beautiful solutions that improve the quality of life for people today and many generations ahead.



Lead multidisciplinary design for mission‑critical projects

As Lead Architectural Project Manager you will provide overall design leadership. You will align client requirements, technical disciplines and operational priorities, and help teams navigate complexity without losing sight of what creates value - throughout all project phases from concept to handover.



Your key responsibilities will be to:

    Lead multidisciplinary design delivery for data centre projects.
    Ensure coordinated delivery across a large multidisciplinary project team, including discipline leads and international engineering teams.
    Set clear direction, create clarity, and facilitate effective collaboration.
    Oversee project financials, reporting to steering committees, and proactive risk management.

Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

The first step to success in this role is that you are eager to collaborate with the people around you -colleagues, partners and customers. You act respectfully, listen actively and follow through on your commitments. And you remain curious about new perspectives and ways to improve.

On top of that, you will have:

    A relevant educational background in project management, architecture, engineering or a related field.
    Experience working with engineering consultancy, technical advisory or complex infrastructure projects.
    Experience from data centre projects or other large‑scale, mission‑critical facilities.
    Experience leading large, multidisciplinary project teams.
    Professional proficiency in English – verbal and written.

Work location

The role can be based in any of our offices across Scandinavia:

Norway – Oslo, Trondheim or Stavanger.

Sweden – Stockholm or Gothenburg.

Denmark – Copenhagen or Aarhus.



We work in international and multidisciplinary teams, and many of our projects are delivered across offices and borders.



Do you have more questions?

If you have any unanswered questions about the role or what we have to offer, please reach out to Talent Acquisition Specialist, Mette Gutte on mtgt@COWI.com



Get to know us even better at our website, www.arkitema.com and www.cowi.com



A place to work and so much more

At Arkitema, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. jobs.title: Ohjaaja/ tukihenkilö
jobs.description:
Työtehtävä sisältää sosiaalipalveluiden asiakastyötä, jossa työntekijä tukee ja ohjaa alaikäistä asiakasta hänen yksilöllisten tarpeidensa mukaisesti. Asiakas on autismikirjon nuori, jolla voi esiintyä haastavaa käyttäytymistä sekä ajoittain aggressiivista käyttäytymistä itseään tai muita kohtaan.

Työ edellyttää työntekijältä erityisesti rauhallisuutta, kärsivällisyyttä, rohkeutta ja hyvää tilannetajua. Työntekijän tulee osata toimia haastavissa tilanteissa turvallisesti, ennaltaehkäistä tilanteiden kärjistymistä sekä rauhoittaa asiakasta ammattimaisesti ja hänen tarpeensa huomioiden.

Työhön kuuluu asiakkaan arjen tukeminen, turvallisuuden ylläpitäminen, toimintakyvyn edistäminen, ohjaaminen sekä asiakkaan kanssa toimiminen hänen yksilöllisen suunnitelmansa mukaisesti. Työntekijältä edellytetään hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja, vastuullista työotetta, kykyä toimia itsenäisesti sekä valmiutta kohdata haastavia tilanteita rauhallisesti ja turvallisesti.

Tehtävä sopii henkilölle, jolla on kokemusta autismikirjon henkilöiden kanssa työskentelystä, haastavasta käyttäytymisestä tai muista vaativista sosiaalipalveluiden asiakastilanteista. Aikaisempi kokemus on eduksi, mutta tärkeää on myös aito halu oppia, hyvä paineensietokyky ja kyky säilyttää rauhallinen ja ammatillinen toimintatapa haastavissakin tilanteissa.

jobs.title: Key Account Manager, Powerbox
jobs.description:
About Powerbox

PRBX is a leading manufacturer of high-performance power conversion products. We deliver innovative and reliable custom solutions across diverse industries, from medical technology and railway applications to defense and industrial automation. With a commitment to constant development and a focus on building strong client partnerships, Powerbox offers a dynamic and rewarding work environment.

Job description

We are searching for a highly motivated and driven Key Account Manager to join our team in Stockholm. You will be responsible for developing and managing long term business relationships with our key clients in the Nordics, focusing on power conversion systems and custom solutions.

Responsibility and tasks

    Develop and maintain strong relationships with key clients in the assigned territory.

    Identify and pursue sales opportunities, driving revenue growth.

    Lead the entire sales process, from prospecting to closing deals.

    Collaborate closely with internal teams to ensure timely delivery and customer satisfaction.

    Provide technical guidance and tailor solutions to meet client requirements.

    Conduct negotiations and finalize contracts with clients.

    Manage customer forecast, prepare sales reports and territory updates.

    Stay abreast of industry trends and competitor activities to inform sales strategies.

Qualifications

You have:

    Proven experience as a high-performing Key Account Manager or similar sales role, preferably within the power electronics industry.

    A deep understanding of power conversion and its applications.

    Strong negotiation and communication skills, with the ability to build trust and rapport with clients at all levels.

    Experience successfully managing complex sales cycles (ideally 6 months or longer).

    Fluency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken.

    Self-motivated and capable of working independently, yet also a collaborative team player.

    Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

    Proficiency in CRM software a plus.

    Willingness to travel within the Nordics for client meetings and industry events.

Personality

To be successful in the role we believe you:

    A highly motivated and results-driven individual with a strong work ethic.

    You possess excellent communication skills and can effectively convey technical information to clients.

    Are a strategic thinker with the ability to identify opportunities and develop innovative solutions.

    Thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced environment, adapting quickly to changing circumstances.

    You are resilient and persistent, able to navigate and persevere through long and complex sales cycles.

    Are customer-focused, dedicated to providing exceptional service and building long-term relationships.

What we offer

At Powerbox, we offer a stimulating environment where you'll embark on a journey of professional growth and development. As a Key Account Manager, you'll lead sales efforts in the Swedish market, engage in challenging projects that drive our company's success. We provide competitive compensation packages, including salary, benefits, and incentives, to attract and retain top talent in the industry. With a strong emphasis on work-life balance, we offer flexible arrangements to ensure your well-being both inside and outside of work. Our culture is rooted in excellence, empowering you to excel in your role and contribute to our continuous growth and success. Take this chance to be part of a team dedicated to innovation, collaboration, and excellence. We look forward to hearing from you!

Application process

Addilon is our partner in this recruitment. Please apply (CV and personal letter in English) via the link. We will fill the position immediately after finding the right candidate. Questions about the position are answered on weekdays between 09.00 am -10.00 am, +46 10 207 43 20.

jobs.title: Tech deployment sr specialist
jobs.description:
Location: Gothenburg or Kungälv, Sweden

Working Pattern: Hybrid, 3-5 days on-site per week

At PMI, we’ve chosen to do something incredible. We’ve transformed our business and are building our future on one clear purpose—to deliver a smoke-free future.

With huge change comes huge opportunity. So, wherever you join us, you’ll enjoy the freedom to dream up and deliver better, brighter solutions and the space to move your career forward in endlessly different directions.

Join our Information Technology team and help shape the digital capabilities that accelerate PMI’s smoke-free transformation. As a Tech Deployment Senior Specialist, you will support the regional deployment of technology solutions by coordinating rollout activities, ensuring site and business readiness, supporting adoption, and securing a smooth transition from project delivery into stable operations.



Impact You'll Own

    Drive regional deployment of technology solutions across markets, sites and business functions.
    Ensure factory and site needs are understood, represented and addressed when central or regional solutions are deployed.
    Identify and escalate functional, operational or support gaps between standard solutions and local business requirements.
    Support simplification of the local technology portfolio by standardizing, consolidating, transitioning or retiring local solutions where possible.
    Secure operational stability through clear ownership, adoption, hypercare and transition from project delivery to support.



What You'll Do

    Plan, coordinate and follow up deployment activities for regional technology initiatives.
    Work closely with factories and stakeholders to understand operational needs, readiness, risks and business impact.
    Assess how central or standard solutions meet local requirements, and flag gaps, risks or required adaptations.
    Maintain ownership of the local application and solution portfolio, including usage, criticality, lifecycle risks and decommissioning opportunities.
    Coordinate go-live, hypercare, portfolio simplification and handover activities with vendors, delivery teams and support organizations.



Skills & Capabilities

    Experience in technology deployment, rollout coordination or implementation of business-critical systems.
    Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to represent factory and site needs in regional or global initiatives.
    Ability to lead or coordinate projects and cross-functional initiatives.
    Understanding of application portfolio management, lifecycle planning, simplification and decommissioning.
    Strong coordination skills across business, technology, vendors, delivery teams and support organizations.
    Knowledge of change management, adoption, hypercare and transition from project delivery to stable operations.



Rewards & Benefits

We offer a comprehensive rewards package including collective barging agreement, health insurance, occupational pension, 30 vacation days a year, a generous sport allowance and beneficial parental leave to name a few.

You will also have the opportunity to grow your career in a global organization, contribute to meaningful transformation, and be part of a team working towards a smoke-free future.



Application Process

To join our team, apply before the 11th of September. Submit your CV in English. All applications will be treated confidentially and screened on an on-going basis. Relocation support is not offered for this role.

The recruitment process consists of phone screening, online assessments, and at least two interview stages.



Equal Opportunities Statement

We believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us stronger. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to creating a workplace where every individual feels welcomed, respected, valued, and empowered to reach their full potential.

We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds and identities, and provide reasonable accommodations to ensure an accessible recruitment process. If you need support or adjustments during your application, let us know—we’re here to help you succeed.

Meidän ihan tavallista arkeamme pääset toteuttamaan vastaanotossamme niin aamu-, ilta- kuin yövuoroissakin.

Tehtävä on määräaikainen ja osa-aikainen (90 h/3 vko) vanhempainvapaan sijaisuus 30.9.2027 asti.

Etsimme toimeen tarttuvaa, positiivisella asenteella työtään tekevää asiakaspalvelijaa. Hallitset sujuvan suomen ja englannin kielen taidon sekä omaat hyvän paineensietokyvyn arjen vaihtelevissa tilanteissa, etkä pelkää itsenäisesti työskentelyä.
Eduksi katsomme aiemman kokemuksen vastaanotossa työskentelystä ja Opera-hotellijärjestelmän käytöstä, mutta ennen kaikkea arvostamme reippautta ja innokkuutta oppia uutta.

Tavalliset työt näkyvät Osuuskauppa Maakunnassa tavassamme huolehtia työntekijöiden hyvinvoinnista ja työturvallisuudesta: Meillä on poikkeuksellisen kattavat henkilöstöedut, kuten alennukset S-ryhmän kaupoissa, ravintoloissa ja hotelleissa. Käytössäsi ovat laajat työterveyshuollon palvelut, vapaa-ajan tapaturmavakuutus, mahdollisuus henkilöstörahastoon sekä ePassin tuoma tuki liikuntaan, kulttuuriin ja hyvinvointiin.
Panostus henkilöstön hyvinvointiin näkyy myös tunnustuksina: Osuuskauppa Maakunta on tänä vuonna palkittu Suomen Innostavimmat työpaikat -kilpailun keskisuurten yritysten sarjassa, sijoituksen perustuessa henkilökunnan työtyytyväisyyskyselyn tuloksiin.

Palkka perustuu matkailu- ja ravitsemisalan työehtosopimukseen ja on kokemusvuosiin perustuen 14,31–15,43 €/tunti. Vuorotyössä peruspalkan päälle maksetaan ilta-, lauantai- ja sunnuntai -lisät. Meillä työryhmillä on mahdollisuus myös tulospalkkioon, joka voi olla jopa 1 €/tehty työtunti.

Lisätietoja antaa:
28.8. klo 9–15: Hotellipäällikkö Milja Manninen puh. 010 783 2825
3.9. klo 8–12: Matkailu- ja ravitsemiskaupan toimialajohtaja Pasi Tolonen puh. 010 76 36005
Hae pian, viimeistään 13.9.2026 mennessä.

Osuuskauppa Maakunta on kainuulaisten asiakasomistajien omistama alueosuuskauppa. Toimialamme ovat päivittäis- ja erikoistavarakauppa, liikennekauppa sekä matkailu- ja ravitsemiskauppa. Myyntimme v. 2025 oli 265 milj. euroa ja työllistämme Kainuussa noin 500 ihmistä.

jobs.title: Mekaniker - service, reparation og vedligeholdelse af lastbiler og opbygninger
jobs.description:
SAWO HERLEV

Mekaniker med blik for teknik, kvalitet og løsninger, der holder

Vil du arbejde med mere end standardreparationer – og blive specialist i hydraulik, el og avancerede opbygninger på lastbiler?

Hos SAWO får du faglige udfordringer, gode kolleger og mulighed for at udvikle dig i en branche, hvor dit håndværk gør en synlig forskel for kunden hver eneste dag.

Bliv en del af holdet i Herlev

Vi har travlt – og det er der en god grund til. SAWO er Danmarks førende specialist i opbygninger og udstyr til lastbiler og entreprenørkøretøjer. Siden 1962 har vi leveret driftssikre, skræddersyede løsninger, og i Herlev har vi brug for endnu en dygtig mekaniker, som vil være med til at holde både udstyr og kundernes hverdag kørende.

Du bliver en del af et erfarent og hjælpsomt værkstedsteam, hvor vi deler viden, hjælper hinanden og går op i at aflevere et stykke arbejde, vi kan være stolte af.

Din hverdag hos os

Du får en varieret arbejdsdag med både planlagte opgaver og faglige udfordringer, der kræver nysgerrighed og en god teknisk forståelse. Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

·     Service, reparation og vedligeholdelse af lastbiler og opbygninger

·     Fejlfinding på mekaniske, hydrauliske og elektriske systemer

·     Montering, tilpasning og klargøring af udstyr

·     Kvalitetssikring og dialog med kolleger om den bedste løsning

·     Bidrag til, at kunderne får driftssikkert udstyr og kortest mulig nedetid

Derfor skal du vælge SAWO

·     Et stærkt fagligt miljø – du arbejder sammen med erfarne specialister og får kolleger, der gerne deler deres viden.

·     Opgaver med variation – du møder forskellige køretøjer, opbygninger og tekniske problemstillinger.

·     Mulighed for at blive endnu dygtigere – vi tilbyder relevante kurser og efteruddannelse.

·     Ordentlige rammer – gode arbejdsforhold, hjælpsomme kolleger og en uformel omgangstone.

·     En arbejdsplads med retning – du bliver en del af en landsdækkende specialistvirksomhed med stolte håndværkstraditioner og stor efterspørgsel.


 

Er det dig, vi leder efter?

Du har en faglig baggrund som mekaniker eller reparatør – eller solid erfaring, der giver dig et stærkt teknisk fundament. Du arbejder selvstændigt, men trives også i et team, hvor man lykkes sammen.

Vi forestiller os desuden, at du:

·     har erfaring med mekanisk montage, fejlfinding og service

·     har flair for hydraulik og el – eller lyst til at lære mere

·     er kvalitetsbevidst og følger opgaven helt til dørs

·     er fleksibel, serviceminded og har forståelse for kundens behov

·     har kørekort til kategori B

Du behøver ikke kunne alt fra første dag. Det vigtigste er, at du har et godt mekanisk fundament, tager ansvar for kvaliteten og har lyst til at udvikle dig sammen med os.

Om SAWO

SAWO leverer, opbygger og servicerer kraner, hejs, ladopbygninger, lifte og specialudstyr til transport- og entreprenørbranchen. Med værksteder og servicepunkter over hele Danmark hjælper vi kunderne hurtigt og kompetent – fra rådgivning og specialopbygning til service, reparation og reservedele.

Bag hver løsning står mennesker med høj faglighed og respekt for godt håndværk. Det gælder også dig, hvis du bliver vores nye kollega.
