jobs.title: Pædagog til SFO og fritidsklub
jobs.description:
Har du lyst til at gøre en forskel for børn, både i skolen og i fritiden? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Vi søger en engageret og fagligt stærk pædagog til vores SFO og fritidsklub, 37 timer om ugen.

Hvem er vi?
Den Fri Hestehaveskole er en levende friskole med mere end 30 års erfaring. Vi ligger midt i skønne, naturskønne omgivelser med fantastiske udeområder, som vi bruger aktivt i hverdagen.

Hver dag møder omkring 200 elever fra 0.-9. klasse og 55 børnehavebørn ind til en skole og et børnehus, hvor leg, læring, trivsel og nysgerrighed går hånd i hånd. Sammen er vi omkring 35 medarbejdere, der driver skole, SFO, klub og naturbørnehave med et fælles ønske om at skabe de bedste rammer for børnene.

Her er rart at være, både for børn og voksne. Som friskole nyder vi friheden til at tænke selv, udvikle os og føre gode idéer ud i livet. Her er plads til initiativ, engagement og store armbevægelser, fordi vi tror på, at de bedste skoler skabes af mennesker, der brænder for deres arbejde.

Du bliver tilknyttet vores SFO og fritidsklub og vil samtidig have timer som støtte i indskolingen. Vi er meget optagede af at skabe sammenhæng mellem skole og fritid, fordi vi tror på, at børn trives og udvikler sig bedst, når de voksne omkring dem arbejder tæt sammen.

Vi arbejder derfor målrettet med at styrke den fælles pædagogiske praksis – til gavn for børnene, fællesskaberne og vores kolleger.

Vi leder efter dig, der:
  • er selvstændig, initiativrig og engageret i dit pædagogiske arbejde
  • har en høj faglighed og kan omsætte den til praksis
  • holder af udeliv, natur, boldspil og bevægelse
  • har lyst til at være initiativtager og tovholder for større og mindre børnegrupper
  • har mod på at være medansvarlig for vores klubtilbud i tæt samarbejde med en kollega
  • kan skabe ro, struktur og tydelighed omkring din pædagogiske praksis
  • kan agere fleksibelt sammen med både børn og kolleger
  • er nysgerrig og opsøger sparring hos kolleger og ledelse, når det er relevant
  • er mødestabil og fleksibel i din tilgang til hverdagen
  • kan arbejde med skriftlig dokumentation, herunder handleplaner og statusbeskrivelser, og formulere mål og delmål samt følge op på dem
  • føler dig forpligtet på opgaven og på det fællesskab, du bliver en del af

Det er et plus, hvis du har erfaring med fritidsklub.

Vi vil noget med vores pædagogiske praksis, skole, SFO og klub.

Vi tror på, at børn har brug for voksne, der både kan sætte retning, skabe tryghed, lege med, udfordre og stille krav. Vi tror på stærke fællesskaber, nærværende voksne og en hverdag, hvor der er plads til både fordybelse, bevægelse, leg og gode relationer.

Derfor leder vi efter en kollega, der ikke bare søger et job, men som har lyst til at blive en vigtig del af vores fællesskab og være med til at skabe den bedste skole, SFO og klub for børnene.

Vi tilbyder
  • En spændende og alsidig stilling på 37 timer
  • En hverdag med både skole-, SFO- og klubpædagogik
  • Dygtige og engagerede kolleger
  • Mulighed for at sætte dit eget præg på aktiviteter og pædagogisk praksis
  • Et tæt samarbejde mellem skole og fritid
  • En arbejdsplads, hvor faglighed, engagement og fællesskab betyder noget

Løn og ansættelse efter overenskomst med BUPL.

Har du lyst til at blive en del af vores fællesskab, er du velkommen til en rundvisning, kontakt afdelingsleder Danny Ibsen på tlf. 86954105 for en aftale.

Stillingen er med foretrukken start 1. november 2026. Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi finder den rette.

jobs.title: TOIMINNANOHJAAJA, Perheentalo –yhteistyö/ MLL:n Iisalmen yhdistys ry
jobs.description:
**Tule mukaan kehittävään varhaisen tuen työtiimiin lasten ja perheiden pariin! Perheentalo –yhteistyö/Mannerheimin Lastensuojeluliiton Iisalmen yhdistys ry** hakee toiminnanohjaajaa (37,5 t/viikko) alkuun 31.01.2027 saakka. Työn jatkuminen varmistuu STEAn avustusehdotusten jälkeen joulukuussa 2026 ja Pohjois-Savon Hyvinvointialueen kumppanuusavustuksen jatkumisesta täysimääräisenä (rahoitus on tällä hetkellä vuoteen 7/2027).

Toiminnanohjaajan työnkuvaan kuuluu puolet työajasta perheiden avoimen kohtaamispaikan Perheentalo Onni ja Ilonan avoimen toiminnan sekä vertaistyhmien suunnittelua ja ohjaamista yhdessä työparin kanssa. Perheentalon kohtaamispaikkatoimintaa toteutetaan tiiviissä yhteistyössä Iisalmen kaupungin avoimen varhaiskasvatuksen kanssa.

Toinen puoli työajasta on itsenäistä jalkautuvaa perheiden avointa kohtaamispaikkatoiminnan suunnittelua ja toteuttamista lähikunnissa eri toimijoiden kanssa yhteistyössä. Seikkailevaa Perheentalon toimintaa on tällä hetkellä Iisalmessa, Rautavaaralla, Kiuruvedellä, Sonkajärvellä, Vieremällä.

Perheentalo -yhteistyö tukee lapsiperheiden arkea ja lisää osallisuuden mahdollisuuksia. Perheentalo toimii verkostomaisesti usean toimijan yhteisvoimin. Perheentalo -toiminnan periaatteet ovat saavutettavuus, yhteisöllisyys, sosiaalisuus, asiantuntijuus, yhdenvertaisuus, osallisuus sekä kestävä kehitys. Toiminnan perustana ovat Lapsen Oikeudet!

Toimintaa rahoitetaan STEA:n ja Pohjois-Savon Hyvinvointialueen sekä Iisalmen kaupungin myöntämillä avustuksilla.

Itä-Suomen alueella toimii viisi Perheentaloa: Iisalmessa www.perheentalo.fi, Joensuussa www.joensuunperheentalo.fi, Kuopiossa www.kuopionperheentalo.fi, Varkaudessa www.ensijaturvakotienliitto.fi/lapsenkengissa/perheentalo/ ja Siilinjärvellä www.siilinjarvenperheentalo.com, jotka muodostavat Perheentalojen Yhteisöllisen kehittämisen verkoston. Lisäksi Perheentalo -yhteistyö on mukana Lastensuojelun Keskusliiton koordinoimassa Perheet Keskiöön -toiminnan kohtaamispaikkaverkostossa.

**Edellytämme** soveltuvaa korkeakoulututkintoa (vähintään AMK-tutkinto tai vastaavat tiedot). Lähikuntiin jalkautuvan työn takia oman auton käyttö on välttämätöntä. Kilometri- ja matkakorvaukset maksetaan.

**Arvostamme** hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja kohtaamisen taitoja ja verkostotyön osaamista. Vapaamuotoiset hakemukset ansioluetteloineen pyydetään toimittamaan sähköisesti torstaihin 3.9.2026 mennessä sinikka.roth@perheentalo.fi. Odotamme yhdelle arkille (A4) laadittua hakemusta. Lisätietoja antaa Perheentalo -yhteistyön johtaja Sinikka Roth 040 743 1773 tai toiminnanohjaaja Riikka Heikkinen riikka.heikkinen@perheentalo.fi 040 1920112.

jobs.title: Spanien Abonnemangssäljare
jobs.description:
Hemsida: https://www.konnect.se/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/konnectse/ Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@konnectse

Är du kvicktänkt, utåtriktad och vill jobba utomlands på ett nytt fräscht kontor med härliga kollegor? Då är du rätt person för oss.

Vi söker nya motiverade säljare till kallkundsförsäljning till vårt kontor i Barcelona. Fast grundlön & provision utan tak!

Har du ingen tidigare erfarenhet? Det är inget krav! Hos oss får du lära dig försäljning från grunden samt hur du använder dig av dina färdigheter för att nå din fulla potential.

Vilka är vi?

Vi jobbar med de största varumärkena inom försäljning och har gjort det i över 10 år. Därför kan vi erbjuda branschens mest attraktiva provisionsmodeller som dem flesta säljare går igång på, utöver en grundlön.

Konnect är Sveriges största säljbolag med kontor i Stockholm och Barcelona. Vi ger våra medarbetare det absolut bästa och vad kan vara bättre än att vara omgiven av likasinnade människor i en stad som Barcelona? Inget, tycker vi!

Vi är störst och vi är bäst på det vi gör men vilka är vi på riktigt? Vi är 300 säljare som alla jobbar för samma sak - att ha kul och njuta av livet. Vi är kollegor men vi är också vänner. Vi jobbar ihop, kämpar och har riktigt kul! Oavsett om vi jobbar eller hänger på stranden så har vi ett gemensamt mål - att vara vårt bästa jag och sälja bra produkter och avtal för de bästa varumärkena inom branschen.

Om tjänsten:

Vi söker dig som är sugen på att arbeta i en stor och snabbväxande koncern och är redo att kavla upp ärmarna när det behövs. I rollen som säljare hos oss vill vi se vilja, driv, kreativitet och ett ”outside-of-the-box” tänk. Vi jobbar på ett ett strukturerat och noggrant tillvägagångssätt för att sälja in en produkt eller ett avtal till företagare och privatpersoner. Du kommer utöver det delta i utbildningar och feedbacksamtal från din teamleader, detta för att ständigt utvecklas och växa i rollen som säljare hos oss.

Vi söker dig som:

Drivs mot uppsatta mål, resultatinriktad och utöver det är en social person som har lätt att ta kontakt med nya människor. Viktigt att du vågar utmana dig själv!

Vad erbjuder vi?

    Hög provision för varje avtal du säljer och spanskt kollektivavtal.
    Daglig coaching och löpande utbildningar för att du ska få de bästa förutsättningarna att lyckas i ditt arbete.
    Fantastiska teamleaders som leder gruppen mot ständig utveckling, motiverar och anordnar tävlingar med otroliga priser varje månad.
    Vi ser till att kombinera arbete med roliga aktiviteter så att gruppen stärks i positiv anda.

Vid flytt till Barcelona:

    Ersättning av flygbiljett.
    Stöd vid letande utav boende.
    Allmänna tips för en utomlandsflytt.
    Stora utvecklingsmöjligheter.
    Ett fantastiskt kontor med ljusa och öppna ytor, 10 minuters lugn promenad från en av Barcelonas vackraste stränder.

Har du fler frågor? Du är varmt välkommen att kontakta oss.

Ansök idag. Vi rekryterar löpande.

Hemsida: https://www.konnect.se/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/konnectse/ Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@konnectse

Vi hjälper många av Sveriges vassaste varumärken i deras försäljning. Under tio års tid har vi byggt upp vår verksamhet och breddat vårt tjänsteutbud för att alltid ligga i framkant. Vårt team består idag av över trehundra drivna och talangfulla medarbetare på våra kontor i Stockholm och Barcelona.

jobs.title: Regional General Manager, France
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

You will lead Notion’s GTM strategy and growth for France, one of EMEA’s largest and highest-priority markets. France is a Tier 1 region in Notion’s country-first EMEA model, with significant room to scale into a standalone, high-growth business.

Notion is shifting from a traditional sales model toward a builder-led model with fewer handoffs, stronger technical fluency, and more direct ownership of customer outcomes. As General Manager, France, you will be the second-line leader responsible for overall revenue outcomes, regional GTM strategy, and the operating model for the French business. You will lead through frontline managers, teams of Business Development Representatives, Solutions Consultants and Outcomes Architects as well as partner cross functionally with Professional Services, Channel Partnerships and RevOps.

This is a hands-on builder-leader role for an AI-native, country-first GTM model. You will bring Notion’s new GTM model to life in France: moving from a segment-first motion to a country-first, AI-native operating system where teams help customers diagnose problems, design agentic workflows, and build real systems with Notion AI.

This role sits on the EMEA Leadership Team and reports to the General Manager, EMEA.

This role will be based in Paris. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own the GTM strategy, operating rhythm, and growth plan for France, with accountability for overall regional revenue outcomes across Sales Assist and Self Serve contribution.

 - Lead as a second-line manager: hire, coach, and develop frontline leaders and IC teams across Business Development, Solutions Consulting, Outcomes Architecture, Forward Deployed Architecture/Engineering, and supporting GTM functions.

 - Scale a country-first GTM motion that brings Notion closer to French customers through local executive engagement, market nuance, and faster field-level decision-making.

 - Accelerate the land engine by opening the right front doors, growing professional workspaces, increasing net-new and upgrade opportunities, and connecting self-serve signals to sales-assisted motion.

 - Win lighthouse customers and turn them into market momentum by making them wildly successful, telling their story locally, and using those wins to influence peer companies across France.

 - Embed Notion’s AI-era GTM model across the team, including agent-enabled customer journeys, first-agent workflow activation, AI/agent demo proficiency, and stronger “build with the customer” motions.

 - Make agentic transformation central to the French GTM motion: help customers identify high-value workflows, build and deploy Notion Agents, automate cross-functional work, and measure outcomes from AI adoption.

 - Partner tightly with Solutions Consultants, Outcomes Architects, Forward Deployed Architects/Engineers, Professional Services, Marketing and Channel to reduce handoffs and deliver faster, more durable customer value.

 - Build “sell with” partner motions in France, including partner-sourced pipeline, co-sell plays, enablement, AI/agentic solution packages, and joint account planning.

 - Establish Notion as a visible force in the French ecosystem through executive dinners, field events, startup and community engagement, partner activations, and customer advocacy.

 - Represent the voice of French customers back to Product, PMM, Marketing, and EMEA leadership, especially around AI transformation, enterprise requirements, security, compliance, localization, and competitive dynamics.

 - Create a talent destination in France by hiring builder-oriented leaders and ICs, raising the craft bar, and developing the next generation of AI-native GTM talent.

 - Drive operational excellence across forecasting, pipeline quality, territory planning, inspection cadence, performance management, and cross-functional execution.




WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR: 

A strategic and hands-on GTM operator who has scaled enterprise SaaS or AI businesses in France and knows how to build a market, not just inherit one. You have led through managers, owned complex revenue outcomes, and created local market momentum through customers, partners, community, and talent.

You combine second-line leadership with builder energy. You can set a crisp country strategy, install the operating system to execute it, and step into the field when needed — whether joining an executive customer conversation, sharpening a pipeline plan, coaching a manager, or helping the team translate a customer problem into an AI-powered, agentic workflow.

You are excited by Notion’s shift to an AI-native, country-first GTM model and believe the best GTM teams will increasingly be builders: BDRs who identify transformation opportunities, Solutions Consultants who build with customers in the room, Outcomes Architects who turn early workflows into durable adoption, and Forward Deployed Architects/Engineers who design the technical systems behind complex agentic workflows.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 12+ years of professional experience, including 5+ years SaaS or AI sales & GTM teams in France.

 - Deep knowledge of the French enterprise and startup ecosystem, including executive buyer networks, local partner channels, and market-specific buying dynamics across all market segments (commercial, midmarket and enterprise)

 - Proven second-line leadership experience, including hiring, coaching, and developing frontline managers and high-performing IC teams.

 - Track record of owning and exceeding revenue targets across new business, expansion, and renewal/churn dynamics.

 - Agency & Urgency: experience building or scaling a regional/country business in a high-growth or ambiguous environment.

 - Experience selling, implementing, or leading GTM teams around AI, automation, agentic workflows, collaboration, productivity, developer, or data products.

 - Strong strategic judgment: ability to define a country plan, segment the market, prioritize accounts and plays, and align cross-functional teams around outcomes.

 - Operational rigor across forecasting, pipeline generation, inspection, performance management, territory planning, and sales process.

 - Executive presence with CIO, CTO, CPO, COO, and business transformation buyers, with the ability to shape a compelling AI and agentic workflow narrative.

 - Strong understanding of modern GTM motions across Business Development, Solutions Consulting, Outcomes Architecture, Forward Deployed Architecture/Engineering, Professional Services, Channel, Marketing, RevOps, and Product.

jobs.description:
Norsktalende selger søkes -- jobb fra hvor du vil i verden

Elventra er etablert i Sverige og opplever sterk vekst. Som en del av vår videre satsing utvider vi nå virksomheten til det norske markedet, og søker derfor 5 motiverte og resultatorienterte selgere som ønsker en fleksibel arbeidshverdag og muligheten til å bygge en attraktiv inntekt.

Dette er en spennende mulighet for deg som trives med salg, kundekontakt og friheten til å jobbe fra hvor du vil i verden. Du vil være med på å bygge opp vår satsing i Norge og bidra til videre vekst innen VVS- og elektrobransjen.

  • Presentere våre tjenester og løsninger

  • Booke møter og gjennomføre salg

Vi ser etter deg som er målrettet, selvstendig og motivert av resultater. For oss er holdning, innsats og arbeidsmoral viktigere enn en lang CV.

  • Du snakker flytende norsk, både muntlig og skriftlig

  • Du har erfaring fra telefonsalg, møtebooking, kundeservice eller lignende

  • Du er strukturert, disiplinert og selvstendig

  • Du trives med å kommunisere med mennesker

  • Du motiveres av resultater og gode prestasjoner

  • Du har egen PC, headset og stabil internettilkobling

Vi tilbyr

  • Attraktiv provisjonsbasert lønn

  • Svært gode inntektsmuligheter for den rette kandidaten

  • Mulighet til å jobbe fra hvor som helst i verden

  • Full fleksibilitet og frihet i arbeidshverdagen

  • Grundig opplæring og tett oppfølging

  • Mulighet for personlig og profesjonell utvikling

  • Langsiktig samarbeid i et selskap i vekst

Om Elventra

Hos Elventra verdsetter vi mennesker som tar ansvar, viser initiativ og ønsker å lykkes. Vi legger stor vekt på holdning, arbeidsmoral og resultater, og gir våre medarbeidere verktøyene og støtten de trenger for å nå sine mål.

Vi er på jakt etter personer som ønsker å være med på en spennende vekstreise og bidra til å bygge vår tilstedeværelse i det norske markedet.

kristofer@elventra.no

Vi behandler søknader fortløpende og ser frem til å høre fra deg.

Arbeidssted

Remote / Hjemmekontor / Valgfritt arbeidssted

Flytende norsk, muntlig og skriftlig

Vil du ha friheten til å jobbe fra hvor du vil, samtidig som du bygger en attraktiv inntekt? Da vil vi gjerne høre fra deg.

Om Elventra

Elventra er en voksende virksomhet med etablerte aktiviteter i Sverige og en ambisiøs satsing på det norske markedet. jobs.title: Tilkallingsvikarer i barnehage
jobs.description:
De kommunale barnehagene i Ålesund trenger flere vikarer og vi søker derfor etter assistenter og fagarbeidere. Vikarene i denne utlysningen vil bli tilknyttet bemanningstjenesten i Barnehager Ålesund Ytre.

Barnehagene i denne virksomheten er Skarbøvik barnehage, Storhaugen barnehage, Midtbyen barnehage og Ellingsøy barnehage

Du som vikar kan velge å arbeide mot en eller flere barnehager etter avtale.

Kandidater blir kontaktet fortløpende.


Arbeidsoppgåver
  • Bidra til at det enkelte barn får medvirke og oppleve positiv grensesetting, både enkeltvis og i gruppe
  • Gi omsorg, støtte og være lyttende i møte med det enkelte barn
  • Delta i daglige rutiner og følge opp barna på en positiv måte
  • Samarbeide med det øvrige personalet i barnehagen
  • Bidra i gjennomføring av det pedagogiske arbeidet på avdelingen/basen, innenfor de rammene man har blitt enige om
  • Følge opp den veiledningen man har fått
  • Ansvar for å sette seg inn i og følge barnehagens HMS-prosedyrer

Kvalifikasjonar
  • Den som blir ansatt, vil måtte legge fram tilfredsstillende politi- og tuberkulinattest
  • Søker må beherske norsk både skriftlig og muntlig.
  • Søkere med et annet førstespråk enn norsk eller samisk må avlegge en norskprøve og ha oppnådd nivå A2 på delprøven i skriftlig framstilling og nivå B1 på delprøvene i leseforståelse, lytteforståelse og muntlig kommunikasjon
    Nivå A2 og B1 skal tilsvare nivå i Det felles europeiske rammeverket for språk, jf. barnehageloven § 18 a.
  • Relevant utdanning og/eller erfaring er ønskelig, men ikke et krav
  • Personlig egnethet blir vektlagt
Personlege eigenskapar

Vi søker deg som

  • Er glad i å være ute
  • Er positiv, fleksibel og løsningsorientert
  • Har et ønske om å arbeide med barn
  • Har god omsorgsevne og evne til å se og lytte til barnas behov
  • Har gode kommunikasjons- og samarbeidsevner
  • Trives i en aktiv hverdag
Vi tilbyr
  • Givende arbeid i gode fag-og arbeidsmiljø.
  • Mulighet til å prøve å arbeide i ulike barnehager.
  • Tilgang til kurs og kompetansehevende tiltak.
  • Lønn etter tariff.
KontaktinformasjonHaldis Gundersen, Virksomhetsleder, 911 51 580, haldis.iren.gundersen@alesund.kommune.no
ArbeidsstadKeiser Wilhelms gate 11
6003 ÅLESUND
Nøkkelinformasjon:Arbeidsgivar: Ålesund kommune

Referansenr.: 5152923593
Stillingsprosent: 100%
Engasjement

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Ålesund kommune er den største kommunen i Møre og Romsdal og den største byen mellom Bergen og Trondheim, med ca. 60 000 innbyggere.

Det lokale næringslivet er både lokalt, nasjonalt og ikke minst internasjonalt orientert. Ålesund er «bygget» på fiske og fangst. Fremdeles er Ålesundsregionen verdensledende innen det marine og maritime området. Flere av landets største fiskebedrifter og oppdrettsselskaper holder til i kommunen vår. Ålesund har Norges største cruisehavn, største fiskerihavn og nest største containerhavn. Vi er også Norges største eksporthavn for fiskeprodukter.

Kommunen er det største kollektivknutepunktet i fylket, og tall fra 2016 viser at det årlig er rundt to millioner passasjerer som går av eller på en buss eller båt i Ålesund.

Ålesund by er vidt kjent for sin vakre jugendstil. Tårn, spir og vakre utsmykninger møter deg når du går gatelangs der. Byen ligger som en døråpner til fjordsystemet på Sunnmøre og strekker seg helt nord til Ona utenfor Romsdalskysten. Andre attraksjoner i kommunen er Ona fyr og fantastiske fjell, fjorder og natur rett utenfor stuedøren.

Vi er en universitetskommune og har et nært samarbeid med NTNU på Campus Ålesund. På Campus Ålesund finner du også Ålesund framtidslab – U4SSC IP.

Kommunen er en stor arbeidsgiver med sine over 4 400 dyktige og engasjerte medarbeidere som utfører viktige samfunnsoppdrag. I det daglige arbeidet vektlegger vi verdiene våre: åpen, engasjert og modig. Visjonen for kommunen er «nasjonal slagkraft, regional attraktivitet og lokal identitet».

Ønsker du en meningsfylt jobb med varierte og utfordrende oppgaver, er Ålesund kommune et spennende alternativ.

jobs.title: Thon Senter Vestkanten søker Driftsmedarbeider - teknisk drift
jobs.description:
Thon Senter Vestkanten søker en engasjert og løsningsorientert driftsmedarbeider med interesse for teknologi og tekniske anlegg. Hos oss får du en sentral rolle i et moderne og komplekst bygg, hvor du bidrar til effektiv drift, gode kundeopplevelser og videre utvikling av bærekraftige løsninger.

Vestkanten er sentrum i Bergen Vest, med et bredt tilbud innen handel, opplevelser, trening og aktivitet. Senteret har en ambisiøs satsing på energioptimalisering og teknologiske løsninger.
 

Ansvarsområder/arbeidsoppgaver:

  • Drift og vedlikehold av tekniske anlegg og installasjoner

  • Daglig drift og vedlikehold av eiendommene

  • Oppfølging av SD-anlegg og byggautomasjon

  • Overvåking og optimalisering av energiforbruk

  • Oppfølging av ventilasjon, varme- og kjøleanlegg

  • Drift av solcelleanlegg og energiløsninger

  • Feilsøking og forbedringsarbeid

  • Samarbeid med leietakere, leverandører og kolleger

Stillingen inngår i turnus- og vaktordning.

Har du kompetansen og egenskapene vi ser etter?

Du er en praktisk og strukturert person med interesse for tekniske systemer. Du trives med ansvar, tar initiativ og jobber godt både selvstendig og i team.

Vi tror du kjenner deg igjen i følgende:

  • Løsningsorientert og pålitelig

  • Strukturert og opptatt av kvalitet

  • Nysgjerrig på teknologi og nye løsninger

  • God samarbeidsevne og kommunikasjon

  • Trives i et variert og til tider hektisk miljø

Kvalifikasjoner:

  • Fagbrev som automatiker, elektriker (gruppe L) eller tilsvarende

  • Erfaring fra teknisk drift, eiendom eller byggautomasjon er en fordel

  • Interesse for energioptimalisering og tekniske systemer

  • Gode IT-kunnskaper og gjerne erfaring med SD-/FDV-systemer

  • Førerkort klasse B

Vi tilbyr:

  • Et inkluderende og faglig sterkt arbeidsmiljø

  • Varierte og selvstendige arbeidsoppgaver i et komplekst bygg

  • Mulighet for faglig utvikling og kompetanseheving

  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser

  • Fri telefon

  • Tilgang til trening (SATS)

  • Rabatterte priser på Thon-hoteller

  • Fri adgang til Vestkanten Opplevelser for deg og din familie

  • Gratis parkering

Hos oss blir du en del av et fremoverlent miljø med fokus på teknologi, effektiv drift og bærekraft. Du får jobbe tett på moderne tekniske anlegg og bidra til å videreutvikle et av Bergens mest spennende kjøpesentre.

Har du spørsmål om stillingen, ta gjerne kontakt med Driftssjef Thon Senter Vestkanten, Geirmund Hopland. Telefon: 992 59 592 eller geirmund.hopland@thon.no

jobs.title: Senior RF Systems & Hardware Engineer – Coherent RF Architecture
jobs.description:
Description & Expectation

Quadsat is looking for an experienced RF Systems & Hardware Engineer to join the RF team working on SpectraLoc, our defense product for detection, analysis, and geolocation of RF emitters.

This role will focus on RF front-end architecture, coherent receiver design, RF chain optimization, PCB design and layout, measurement integrity, and the continued productization of SpectraLoc. You will help strengthen the RF hardware foundation needed for robust product performance, certification readiness, and future next-generation RF architectures.

SpectraLoc combines RF sensing payloads, drone-based operations, mission control software, signal processing, geolocation algorithms, and operator-facing workflows into one integrated product. You will work closely with engineers spanning from RF, DSP, software, embedded, and FPGA specialist, with your primary focus being to improve RF system quality, hardware robustness, and the measurement integrity of the sensing chain.


Responsibilities:

Your main responsibility will be to develop, improve, and mature RF hardware and RF system architectures that support reliable RF sensing, geolocation, and future coherent receiver capabilities.

You will:

  • Design, develop, and optimize RF front-end architectures for RF sensing and geolocation applications.
  • Contribute to coherent receiver design, multi-channel RF architectures, and future direction-finding capabilities based on phase-coherent RF measurements.
  • Design and improve RF chains, including filtering, amplification, frequency conversion, gain distribution, dynamic range, noise figure, linearity, and sensitivity trade-offs.
  • Support PCB design and layout for RF circuits, including component selection, schematic design, layout review, signal integrity, grounding, shielding, and manufacturability.
  • Improve measurement integrity across the RF sensing chain by identifying and reducing sources of uncertainty, drift, phase error, loss, interference, leakage, and calibration sensitivity.
  • Plan and perform RF measurements, verification, and troubleshooting using relevant RF test equipment such as spectrum analysers, VNAs, signal generators, power meters, and related tools.
  • Work with DSP and software engineers to ensure that RF hardware behavior, calibration data, and system limitations are understood and properly reflected in algorithm development and product performance.
  • Support product robustness, certification readiness, and design-for-manufacturing activities by improving RF hardware quality, documentation, repeatability, and testability.
  • Provide technical leadership within RF systems and hardware, helping raise the quality of Quadsat’s RF design, validation methodology, and overall sensing performance.


Knowledge & Skills:

We envision that you have a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, RF Engineering, Microwave Engineering, Physics, or a related technical field, combined with strong practical experience in RF hardware development for RF sensing, SDR, radar, electronic warfare, SATCOM, aerospace, telecom, test and measurement, or other advanced RF systems.

More important than the exact degree is that you have hands-on experience designing, validating, and improving RF systems where measurement quality, robustness, and system performance matter.

In addition, you bring:

  • Strong practical experience with RF front-end design, RF chain architecture, and RF hardware development.
  • Experience with RF circuit design and PCB design/layout for high-frequency systems.
  • Solid understanding of RF system trade-offs, including gain, noise figure, dynamic range, linearity, filtering, frequency conversion, phase noise, spurious signals, leakage, and sensitivity.
  • Practical experience with RF measurement, verification, debugging, and calibration using professional RF test equipment.
  • Understanding of coherent RF systems, including phase stability, synchronization, channel matching, LO distribution, timing effects, and calibration considerations.
  • Familiarity with antenna interfaces, propagation effects, polarization, multipath, and how RF hardware behavior affects sensing and geolocation performance.
  • Ability to define test methods, performance metrics, acceptance criteria, and validation approaches for RF hardware and RF sensing systems.
  • Experience collaborating with DSP, software, embedded, FPGA, mechanical, robotics, and product teams to turn RF hardware concepts into robust product capabilities.
  • A proactive mindset, strong ownership, and the ability to work independently while staying aligned with broader product and engineering priorities.

It would be highly advantageous if you also have experience with electronic warfare, radar systems, SIGINT, RF surveillance, phased arrays, coherent multi-channel receivers, interferometry, monopulse tracking, beamforming, calibration of RF sensing systems, MIL-STD certification, environmental robustness, SDR platforms, or transitioning RF hardware from prototype into production.


Our Dynamic Work Environment:

Quadsat is at an exciting stage of our growth journey where you can make a meaningful impact with your work, and directly influence the development of advanced solutions. You will join a diverse team of innovative colleagues who are passionate about working with new technology development. Our work environment is characterised by a high degree of openness, a flat management structure, and a strong sense of community where we work closely together on tasks.

You will be part of a driven engineering team across software, RF, robotics, and product development, with opportunities for professional growth, increased responsibility, and close involvement in real product innovation. We value initiative, collaboration, high-quality engineering, and people who want their work to matter beyond the codebase.


Contact:

For recruitment related questions contact Human Resources Director, AislinnCampbell, by mail at afc@quadsat.com or by phone at +45 71 74 97 81.

jobs.title: DSP Engineer - RF Sensing & Geolocation
jobs.description:
Description & Expectation

Quadsat is looking for an experienced Digital Signal Processing Engineer to join the RF team working on SpectraLoc, our defense product for detection, analysis, and geolocation of RF emitters.

This role will predominantly involve designing and implementing DSP algorithms for signal classification, interference detection, signal deinterleaving, and geo-localisation within Software Defined Radio (SDR) systems.

SpectraLoc combines RF sensing payloads, drone-based operations, mission control software, signal processing, geolocation algorithms, and operator-facing workflows into one integrated product. You will work closely with RF, software, embedded, FPGA, and product teams, with your primary focus being to develop and validate DSP algorithms that improve sensing performance, robustness, and product quality across defense use cases.


Responsibilities:

Your main responsibility will be to develop, validate, and mature DSP algorithms that improve the performance, robustness, and quality of Quadsat’s RF sensing and geolocation capabilities.

  • Design, prototype, and validate DSP algorithms for RF signal classification, interference detection, demodulation, signal analysis, and geo-localization within Software Defined Radio (SDR) systems.
  • Develop algorithm concepts, reference implementations, and validation tools in Python, MATLAB, or similar technical computing environments.
  • Work with recorded and live RF data to evaluate algorithm performance, identify limitations, and improve robustness under real-world conditions such as noise, interference, multipath, calibration errors, and synchronization effects.
  • Contribute to direction finding and RF sensing capabilities, including methods such as AoA, TDOA, interferometry, monopulse processing, beamforming, tracking, and related estimation techniques.
  • Define test methods, performance metrics, and acceptance criteria for DSP algorithms, including accuracy, sensitivity, stability, robustness, and failure modes.
  • Collaborate with software, embedded, FPGA, and RF engineers to support the transition of validated algorithms into product-ready implementations.
  • Provide technical leadership within DSP and RF sensing, helping raise the quality of Quadsat’s algorithm development, validation methodology, and overall sensing performance.


Knowledge & Skills:

We envision that you have a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Signal Processing, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or a related technical field, combined with strong practical experience in DSP development for RF, SDR, radar, electronic warfare, SATCOM, aerospace, telecom, or other advanced sensing systems.

More important than the exact degree is that you have hands-on experience developing and validating DSP algorithms on real RF data.

In addition, you bring:

  • Strong practical experience with digital signal processing for RF and Software Defined Radio systems.
  • Proven ability to develop, prototype, and validate DSP algorithms in Python, MATLAB, or similar technical computing environments.
  • Experience working with real RF measurement data, including noisy or imperfect data from SDRs, radar, EW, SATCOM, telecom, or related systems.
  • Solid understanding of RF signal chains, including sampling, bandwidth, filtering, SNR, synchronization, phase, and calibration effects.
  • Experience with signal detection, classification, interference analysis, signal characterization, or geolocation-related signal processing.
  • Experience with direction finding or RF sensing techniques such as AoA, TDOA, interferometry, monopulse processing, beamforming, triangulation, tracking, or related estimation methods.
  • Ability to define validation methods, performance metrics, test cases, and acceptance criteria for DSP algorithms.
  • Familiarity with SDR platforms and practical deployment constraints such as real-time processing, data throughput, latency, synchronization, and hardware limitations.
  • A proactive mindset, strong ownership, and the ability to work independently while collaborating closely with RF, software, embedded, FPGA, robotics, and product teams.

It would be highly advantageous if you also have experience with electronic warfare, radar development, SIGINT, RF surveillance, coherent multi-channel RF systems, C/C++ implementation, FPGA-based DSP, embedded DSP, fixed-point processing, CUDA, VHDL, Verilog, calibration, or transitioning algorithms from prototype into operational products.


Our Dynamic Work Environment:

Quadsat is at an exciting stage of our growth journey where you can make a meaningful impact with your work, and directly influence the development of advanced solutions. You will join a diverse team of innovative colleagues who are passionate about working with new technology development. Our work environment is characterised by a high degree of openness, a flat management structure, and a strong sense of community where we work closely together on tasks.

You will be part of a driven engineering team across software, RF, robotics, and product development, with opportunities for professional growth, increased responsibility, and close involvement in real product innovation. We value initiative, collaboration, high-quality engineering, and people who want their work to matter beyond the codebase.

jobs.title: PhD Position - Biochemical Bioprospecting of Macroalgae
jobs.description:
This is Nord University

Would you like to help create knowledge that makes a difference? At Nord University, we develop future solutions through education, research, and collaboration with the society around us.

Together, we shape the future with roots in the North and our eyes on what lies ahead.

Nord in the world - knowledge for the future.

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KWoZi6o-EB4About the position

Faculty of Biosciences and Aquaculture, Nord University, Norway, invites applications from outstanding candidates for a three- or four-year PhD position in Macroalgal biochemical bioprospecting. 

This position offers the opportunity to explore the chemical diversity and biological activity of phenolic compounds from cold-adapted macroalgae. Using advanced analytical platforms, the candidate will be able to characterize these compounds, besides employing cell-lines/ model organisms to investigate their antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties at the molecular level. The project supports the faculty’s translational research on chronic intestinal inflammation, a major health challenge in humans attributed to diet and other factors. The association of this disease condition with oxidative stress and dysregulated cellular processes creates interest not only in elucidating the underlying mechanisms, but also to explore the application of algae-derived compounds in conjunction with preventive health strategies. Macroalgae are a promising and sustainable source of phenolic compounds, and their biological activities have been demonstrated in different experimental systems. However, due to their chemical complexity and structural variability, their mode of biological action needs to be studied further. Phlorotannins typically occur as complex mixtures of structurally related compounds, while catechins are secondary metabolites occurring in bound and free forms, conjugated to cell wall polymers making their characterization and biological evaluation challenging. The candidate applying for the position should have adequate expertise either in analytical chemistry or possess advanced skills in molecular cell biology to undertake this applied research project

This research project, which is partly externally funded, is a collaboration between Nord University and NIBIO at their respective research divisions in Bodø, Norway, providing access to strong research environments, interdisciplinary supervision, and state‑of‑the‑art laboratory facilities.

Candidates must comply with Nord University’s residency requirements.


Qualification requirements
  • The ideal candidate for this position must possess an MSc degree in biosciences, biochemistry, cell biology or a discipline relevant for the announced position. A grade average of B or better (or equivalent score) is required for both the program overall and the master’s thesis to be admitted to the PhD program. Applicants from outside the EU/EEA must submit approval of their master’s degree, https://hkdir.no/en/foreign-education 
  • The ideal candidate would have undertaken a master’s thesis project on seaweed chemistry, and have a sound background on structure, diversity and ecological roles of compounds, particularly phlorotannins. Expertise in seaweed biomass handling and growing them under laboratory conditions, and sample preparation from the biomass for downstream analyses will be advantageous for the position. In addition, if a candidate has gained skills in analytical techniques, using HPLC, LC-MS, LC-MS/QTOF, or related platforms for phlorotannin characterization, this can be of significant benefit for conducting the PhD project
  • The candidate must have the ability to process, curate and interpret analytical data sets and prepare scientific publication. The candidate should also be able to work independently while collaborating effectively across disciplines. The candidate must be strong in scientific communication skills in English, across multiple platforms
  • See admission requirements:  PhD in Biosciences Employment is conditional upon admission to the faculty’s doctoral program. The final project proposal must be submitted within three months of appointment. Termination may be considered if admission to the doctoral program is not obtained within this deadline, or in cases of failure to submit annual progress reports and/or serious deficiencies in progress or duty work. For admission requirements and regulations, see our web page
  • It can be beneficial if the applicant masters Norwegian or a Scandinavian language
    For the position, good English skills are required both written and oral. The thesis must be written in English

Candidates who already have a PhD degree will not be considered for the position.


Qualified applicants will be ranked according to the following criteria:
  • Themes and perspectives from the applicant’s master’s study. Project outline with description of project idea and plan for implementation
  • The applicant’s description of motivation for the doctoral work and opportunities for completion
  • Relevant experience from research work
  • Ability to work independently, goal-oriented and systematically
  • Personal suitability

We offer

The annual salary for doctoral researchers (code 1017) is NOK 565 000,-.

  • Advantages within the Government Pension Fund for loans, insurance and pension
  • Creative and collegial working environment
  • A workplace with progressive development
  • Flexible working hours  
  • Active university sports team

General information

The state workforce should reflect the diversity of the population. Nord University therefore encourages qualified candidates with disabilities, gaps in their CV, an immigrant background, and otherwise diverse life experiences to apply.

Information regarding disabilities or gaps in a CV may be used for anonymized statistical purposes.

The person appointed must comply with the applicable laws, agreements, and directives. The responsibilities and duties associated with the position may change with future reorganization at Nord University.

Nord University is subject to the Security Act, which imposes requirements for the handling of protected and sensitive information. To enhance the security of recruitment processes, Nord may conduct background checks of relevant candidates. 
Security suitability will be considered.


Application process

Applicants will be evaluated by an internal expert committee. Relevant applicants will be invited for an interview, trial lecture or other presentations. For more information, see Nord`s website .

The Faculty reserves the right not to hire applicants who may be scientifically qualified, but who do not meet other criteria such as language, educational background or personal characteristics.


Application

Applications must be submitted electronically by 10.09.2026

The application should include:

  • Application letter with description of your motivation for applying for the position
  • Complete CV (education, work and teaching experience and overview of any scientific publications
  • A project description (maximum 3 pages), based on the theme mentioned earlier in this announcement, including the theoretical anchoring, methodological approaches, and a progress plan for the three-year fellowship period. If you have employed AI-powered generative language models to prepare the project description, a declaration must be included at the end of the document, stating the extent to which you have relied on such models.
  • Copy of diploma for both bachelor and master education and relevant certificates. Diplomas from outside the EU/EEA must submit approval of their master’s degree, https://hkdir.no/en/foreign-education
  • Copy of the applicant’s master’s thesis as a PDF file
  • Name and contact information of 2-3 references (name, your relation to the person, email and phone number)
  • Any other activity that is considered relevant for the position

All documents (only those asked for) must be uploaded as PDF attachments to the electronic application form.

It is the applicant's responsibility to submit the complete documentation within the deadline.

Once the application period has ended a list of applicants will be published. Note that, in special cases, the identity of particular applicants to a position may be made public even when that applicant has requested that their application be processed confidentially. Applicants requesting an exemption from publication of their identity must explain their reasons for doing so in their application. In this case, advance notice will be given in the event of a decision to make any information about the applicant public.

jobs.title: Senior Research Fellow (Information and knowledge management) / Yliopistotutkija (tietojohtaminen)
jobs.description:
Tampere University aims at scientific excellence and societal impact in research. Its focus areas are technology, health, and society. The university regards the competence of staff as its most important strategic asset and supports its development. For further information, please visit www.tuni.fi/en.

[The Unit of Information and Knowledge Management](https://www.tuni.fi/en/tau/information-and-knowledge-management) in the Faculty of Management and Business was established in 2001. The unit operates in the broad field of information and knowledge management, ranging from information technology and business to people, organisations and society.The unit currently has eight professors and approximately 45 staff members who conduct research, teach and create societal impact in many ways.

We are now seeking a new Senior Research Fellow to strengthen high-quality research and teaching, contribute to the acquisition of competitive research funding, and foster national and international research collaboration.

The units research activities are organized around three strategic focus areas that generate new knowledge and value, often through multidisciplinary research activities. The first focus area, knowledge-based management, includes classical knowledge management, intellectual capital, and business and data analytics, complemented by a perspective on data-driven decision-making. The second area, management of information systems, covers various topics related to information systems, from their management and use to their implementation, deployment and impacts, as well as details related to IT governance. The third area, management of digital business, addresses the digitalization of processes and services, the development and utilization of business models, the data economy, ecosystems, various business support platforms and platform technologies. Depending on the applicants profile, the open position may be located in any of these three focus areas.

Job description

A Senior Research Fellow in information and knowledge management conducts high-quality research and provides teaching in the field of information and knowledge management. The Senior Research Fellow conducts independent research on internationally and nationally relevant themes in information and knowledge management, plans research projects, actively participates in applying for research funding and leading projects, and contributes to other university activities, societal interaction in the field and international collaboration. The Senior Research Fellow will also supervise theses of degree students and participate in the supervision of doctoral students.

Requirements

- an applicable doctoral degree
- evidence of high-quality independent scientific research
- strong evidence of acquiring external research funding
- strong and versatile evidence of research collaboration
- evidence of high-level, high-quality research-based teaching and supervision in some of the above-mentioned three strategic focus areas of the unit of Information and knowledge management
- good command of English

University pedagogical studies and other pedagogical merits and experience will also be taken into account. Skills of Finnish language is considered as an advantage.

The selected person is expected to acquire external research funding to cover at least 35% of the salary costs related to the position.

The selection process may include different forms of interviews, aptitude assessments and teaching skills assessments.

We offer

The position is fixed-term and its duration is four years. A six-month trial period applies to all new employees at Tampere University. The starting date is negotiable and will be agreed upon with the selected candidate.

The salary will be based on the [salary system for teaching and research staff at Finnish universities.](https://sivista.fi/in-english/general-collective-agreement-for-universities/) The preliminary requirement level for the University Researcher position is 6–7. In addition, a salary component based on personal performance will be paid. The starting salary (level 6) is approximately EUR 4,700-4,900 per month.

Read more about working at Tampere University: https://www.tuni.fi/en/tau/work-with-us

How to apply

Please submit your application using the universitys electronic application form. The application period for the position ends on 17 September 2026 at 23.59 (EEST / UTC +3).

Please attach the following documents to your application in PDF format:

- Curriculum vitae in accordance with the template of the [Finnish National Board on Research Integrity (TENK)](https://tenk.fi/en/advice-and-materials/template-researchers-curriculum-vitae)
- List of publications in accordance with the guidelines of the [Research Council of Finland](https://www.aka.fi/en/research-funding/apply-for-funding/how-to-apply-for-funding/az-index-of-application-guidelines/list-of-publications/). Mark the five most important publications in the list and add links to them. If the publications cannot be accessed via links, include them as separate PDF files.
- Research plan (max. 5 pages)
- Teaching portfolio, for example in accordance with [Tampere Universitys guidelines](https://content-webapi.tuni.fi/proxy/public/2022-05/tau2020guideline20for20applicants20teaching20portfolio.pdf)
- An appendix in which you explain why you would be suitable for the position and how you would develop your own research and the teaching related to the position.

Further information of the position:

Information Systems Management focus area: Professor Henri Pirkkalainen

Digital Business Management focus area: Professor Hannu Kärkkäinen

Knowledge-Based Management focus area: University Lecturer Pasi Hellsten

Email addresses are in the format: firstname.lastname(at)tuni.fi

For questions concerning the recruitment process, please contact HR Specialist Ilona Pekuri, ilona.pekuri(at)tuni.fi.

**Etsimme tavallisen hyviä tyyppejä**

**HAUSSA TAVALLISEN HYVIÄ STARK RENT YRITYSPALVELUMYYJIÄ PÄÄKAUPUNKISEUDULLE**

Me Starkilla näemme työssämme joka päivä, ettei ammattitaito asu täydellisyydessä, vaan aidossa kiinnostuksessa ja halussa kehittyä. Dynaamisen ihmeidentekijän tai superyli-ihmisten sijaan etsimme riveihimme tavallisen hyviä tyyppejä – tällä kertaa STARK Rent yrityspalvelumyyjän tehtäviin.

**Haemme pääkaupunkiseudulle STARK Rent yrityspalvelumyyjiä vakituisiin työsuhteisiin**

STARK Rent on palveleva konevuokraamo, josta rakentaja vuokraa ammattilaistason rakennuskoneita ja laitteita isompiin ja pienempiin tarpeisiinsa. STARK Rent konevuokraamon palvelut ovat erinomainen apu niin ammattirakentajalle kuin kodin tai pihan kunnostajalle. STARK Rent -konevuokraamot palvelevat STARK rakennustarvikeliikkeiden yhteydessä pääkaupunkiseudulla, Turussa ja Tampereella. Vuokraa koneet – ja keskity rakentamiseen.

Tehtäviisi kuuluvat mm. asiakaspalvelu, työmaa- ja asiakaskäynnit sekä uusasiakashankinta. Työtäsi tukemassa on vahva brändi sekä Starkin tehokas ja joustava logistiikka.

Toivomme, että sinulla on halua ja intoa hyvään asiakaspalveluun. Olet myyntihenkinen, positiivinen ja oma-aloitteinen,ja haluat auttaa asiakkaitamme löytämään heille sopivat tuotteet, palvelut ja ratkaisut. Rakennusala kehittyy ja rakentajien tarpeet muuttuvat. Toivomme että myös sinä haluat kehittyä, haastaa vanhaa ja oppia uutta.

Arvostamme vuokrausalan ja rakennuskoneiden tuntemusta. Rakennusalan tai kaupallisen alan koulutus, tai vastaava työkokemus katsotaan eduksesi. Toivomme valmiutta käsitellä nostimia, trukkeja ja muita vastaavia laitteita. Sinulla on myös ajokortti ja oman auton käyttömahdollisuus.

**Millaista joukkoa me starklaiset olemme?**

Perehdytämme työhön, opastamme talon tapoihin, otamme mukaan porukkaan ja maksamme asiallista palkkaa. Emme lupaile elämää suurempaa, vaan tavallisia, hyviä töitä meille tavallisille, hyville tekijöille. Tosi Starkoituksella.

Olemme luotettava ja vastuullinen työnantaja, jonka arvot reiluus, intohimo ja ammattiylpeys kertovat siitä, mikä työntekijöitämme yhdistää ja millaista toimintakulttuuria haluamme luoda. Haluamme rakentaa parempaa huomista yhdessä asiakkaidemme ja kumppaneidemme kanssa ja olemme sitoutuneet YK:n 1,5°C ilmastotavoitteeseen. Saat meiltä kullan arvoista työkokemusta, reilun työyhteisön sekä henkilöstön ostoedut heti käyttöösi. Opit samalla myyntityön ja saat perehdytyksen rakennusalan työhön alan ammattilaiselta.

Tarjoamme avuksesi rakennustarvikkeiden ja pintamateriaalien kattavan valikoiman ja palvelut, joista löytyvät rakentavan asiakkaasi tarpeisiin sopivat ratkaisut. Saat työkavereiksesi huipputiimin, jotka rakennusalan ammattilaisina perehdyttävät sinut työhösi. Työtäsi tukemassa on vahva brändi ja konsepti sekä Starkin tehokas ja joustava logistiikka.

Erfarenhet av mötesbokning, försäljning eller kundkontakt är meriterande, men inget krav. Det viktigaste är din inställning, din vilja att utvecklas och din förmåga att skapa förtroende i samtal med svenska företag.

Du blir en del av ett team där kvalitet, struktur, samarbete och personlig utveckling är centralt.

Dina kvalifikationer

    Flytande svenska i tal och skrift
    God kommunikativ förmåga och lätt för att skapa relationer
    Intresse för B2B-kommunikation och professionell kundkontakt
    Positiv inställning och vilja att lära dig nya färdigheter
    Förmåga att arbeta strukturerat och målinriktat
    Erfarenhet inom mötesbokning, försäljning eller kundservice är meriterande men inget krav

Lön och förmåner

    Fast anställning på kontoret i Málaga
    Grundlig introduktion och utbildning inom alla projekt
    Möjlighet att arbeta med flera olika branscher och målgrupper

    Löpande utvecklingsmöjligheter inom försäljning och rådgivning
    En arbetsmiljö där kvalitet prioriteras framför kvantitet

Vad får du ut av att arbeta hos oss?

    Praktisk erfarenhet av professionell B2B-kommunikation
    Möjlighet att utveckla dina färdigheter inom försäljning, rådgivning och affärsutveckling
    Inblick i spännande branscher som HR, IT, fintech och företagslösningar

    Ett liv och en karriär i soliga Málaga

    Ett engagerat team med fokus på samarbete, utveckling och resultat

jobs.title: Work as a GP in scenic Western Norway
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Europe. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!

Would you like to work in a well-organised GP practice with experienced colleagues, close access to specialist healthcare, and excellent opportunities for outdoor activities?

On behalf of a municipality in Vestland County, we are recruiting a family medicine specialist for a permanent position in a modern and well-established GP practice.

This is an opportunity to join a supportive professional environment where quality of care, collaboration, and continuity for patients are highly valued. The practice is located in a scenic area of Western Norway, surrounded by mountains, lakes, and fjords, with easy access to both outdoor activities and urban amenities.

About the position

You will join a GP practice consisting of three experienced GPs and one resident doctor. The available patient list currently includes approximately 800 patients, with the possibility of gradually increasing the list size if desired.

The municipality places great emphasis on creating a positive working environment and maintaining a strong professional community with skilled colleagues and experienced support staff.

The position includes:

    Responsibility for your own patient list
    Diagnosis, treatment, and long-term follow-up of patients of all ages
    Preventive healthcare and chronic disease management
    Up to 20% municipal medical duties
    Participation in an organised out-of-hours emergency service rotation

Emergency care services

The municipality participates in an intermunicipal emergency care collaboration involving five municipalities. The emergency clinic is located next to the local hospital and operates from dedicated facilities.

    The service includes responsibility for:
    Out-of-hours emergency care
    Municipal acute care beds (KAD)
    Emergency medical communication centre
    The clinic is staffed by qualified healthcare personnel around the clock, providing a well-supported working environment during emergency shifts.

We offer

    Permanent full-time position
    Annual salary of approx. NOK 1.6 million for specialists, plus additional compensation for emergency service duties
    A well-established GP practice with experienced colleagues
    Strong professional support and collaboration
    Good opportunities for professional development and continuing education
    Assistance with relocation and practical arrangements when moving to Norway
    Free Norwegian language training
    Support throughout the authorisation process

About the area

The position is located in a municipality in Vestland County, one of Norway's most spectacular regions. The area is known for its fjords, mountains, glaciers, and excellent opportunities for hiking, skiing, cycling, and fishing.

The community offers schools, cultural activities, sports facilities, and a wide range of local services. The location also provides good transport connections to larger towns and cities in Western Norway.

Qualifications

We are looking for candidates who:

    Are specialists in family medicine / general practice (GP)
    Hold a valid medical licence and specialist recognition from an EU/EEA country
    Have good English language skills
    Are motivated to learn Norwegian
    Have good communication and collaboration skills
    Wish to establish a long-term career and life in Norway

Why Norway?

General practitioners play a central role in the Norwegian healthcare system and are responsible for the long-term follow-up of their own patients. Norwegian healthcare is characterised by high professional standards, collaborative working environments, and a high degree of professional autonomy.

Norway also offers excellent opportunities to combine a medical career with a balanced lifestyle, family life, and access to nature.

Interested?

We would be happy to tell you more about the position and life in Norway. Please contact us for a confidential conversation or send us your CV. We look forward to hearing from you!

You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

jobs.title: Hitsaaja-asentaja Lohjalle
jobs.description:
Haemme asiakasyrityksellemme Jamenet Oy:lle hitsaaja-asentajaa pitkäaikaiseen työsuhteeseen Lohjalle. **Etsimme käytännönläheistä ja monipuolista hitsaaja-asentajaa, joka viihtyy vaihtelevissa työtehtävissä** teollisuuden kunnossapidon parissa ja haluaa päästä tekemään **koneiden ja laitteiden hitsaus-, korjaus-, asennus- ja kunnossapitotöitä konepajaympäristössä.**

Korjattavana ja huollettavana on monenlaisia teollisuuden koneita ja laitteita, kuten stabilointikoneita, kahmareita ja muita työkoneita. Työt vaihtelevat pienemmistä komponenteista hyvinkin raskaisiin koneisiin. Kokemus esimerkiksi myös pumppujen parissa työskentelystä katsotaan eduksi. **Toivommekin, että sinulla on kokemusta erilaisista teollisuuden kunnossapidon tehtävistä ja hitsausosaamisesi on hyvällä tasolla.** Luokkahitsari yrityksestä löytyy valmiina, joten luokkia sinulla ei tarvitse olla suoritettuna.

Jamenet Oy toimii Lohjan Muijalan teollisuusalueella yhdessä Sideko Oy:n kanssa. Yrityksessä tehdään monipuolisesti koneistus-, hitsaus-, asennus- ja kunnossapitotöitä. Työyhteisö on huumorintajuinen noin 15 hengen pieni ja mutkaton tiimi, jossa työntekijät ovat viihtyneet pitkään.

**Työt alkavat nopealla aikataululla heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.** Työtä tehdään yhdessä vuorossa maanantaista perjantaihin ja aloitus on liukuvasti klo 6-7 välillä. Työpäivän pituus on 8,5h sisältäen palkattoman 30 minuutin ruokatauon. Onhan sinulla oma auto liikkumista varten.

Mitä työ pitää sisällään:

**Työtehtävät ovat monipuolisia ja vaihtelevat tilanteen mukaan. Pääset tekemään muun muassa**

- Asennushitsausta

- Korjaushitsausta

- Koneiden ja laitteiden korjaus- ja asennustöitä

- Pajalle tuotujen koneiden ja komponenttien kunnostamista

- Teollisuuden kunnossapitotöitä

- Koneenosien ja rakenteiden korjaamista ja kokoonpanoa


Toivomme sinulta:

- Aiempaa työkokemusta hitsauksesta sekä teollisuuden kunnossapidon asennus- ja korjaustehtävistä

- MIG/MAG-hitsauksen osaamista

- Kokemusta asennus- ja korjaustöistä

- Kykyä työskennellä itsenäisesti

- Valmiutta tehdä monipuolisia konepaja- ja kunnossapitotöitä

- Oma-aloitteista ja huolellista työotetta

- Halua oppia uutta

- Hyvää suomen kielen osaamista

- Omaa autoa


**Kone- ja tuotantotekniikan koulutus on eduksi, mutta käytännön työkokemus on tärkeintä.**

**Tulityö- ja työturvallisuuskorteista ei ole haittaa, mutta niitä ei edellytetä oman verstaan työtehtävissä. Myöskään erillisiä luokkahitsauspätevyyksiä ei vaadita – tärkeintä on, että hitsaus onnistuu käytännössä.**

Tarjoamme sinulle:

- Pitkäaikaisen työpaikan monipuolisten teollisuuden kunnossapidon tehtävien parissa

- Mahdollisuuden kehittyä ja oppia uusia työmenetelmiä

- Työvaatteet ja henkilönsuojaimet työnantajan puolesta

- Palkkauksen osaamisen ja kokemuksen mukaan, noin 14–24 €/h, Teknologiateollisuuden työehtosopimukseen pohjautuen.


Laita hakemuksesi tulemaan pikaisesti järjestelmän kautta ja lähde mukaan hitsauksen ja asennuksen pariin Jamenetin porukaan! Paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Tarvittaessa voit kysyä lisätietoa sähköpostitse Timanttien Hannalta hanna.kiertonen@timantti.net.

_Timantti Henkilöstöpalvelut auttaa osaajia löytämään työn, joka sopii heidän taitoihinsa ja tavoitteisiinsa. Työllistämme työntekijöitä eri toimialojen monipuolisiin tehtäviin – niin määräaikaisiin, vakituisiin kuin projektiluonteisiinkin työsuhteisiin. Meille työntekijä ei ole vain resurssi, vaan tärkeä osa Timantin yhteisöä. Tarjoamme joustavia ratkaisuja, uusia mahdollisuuksia ja tukea työurasi eri vaiheissa – jotta sinä voit keskittyä siihen, missä olet parhaimmillasi._

jobs.title: Geospatial AI Developer
jobs.description:
**Joensuu preferred | Hybrid/remote within Finland possible | Full-time or part-time alongside studies**

Forest Key is looking for a **Geospatial AI Developer** to strengthen our capacity to develop AI-based solutions for forestry.

We work at the intersection of forestry, remote sensing, GIS, data analytics and software development. The role supports our growing international project portfolio and the development of customer-specific digital solutions for operational forestry.

**Your role**

Your main task will be to develop **AI-based remote-sensing and GIS data-processing solutions for forestry applications**.

The emphasis is on technical development, analytical workflows and robust code rather than polished user-interface development.

Your work may include:

- developing AI and machine-learning solutions using remote-sensing, GIS and forestry data;

- processing and analysing satellite, LiDAR, drone and other large geospatial datasets;

- developing Python-based workflows and maintainable processing pipelines;

- implementing solutions in cloud or other scalable computing environments; and

- supporting technical demonstrations, customer discussions and solution development.


**What we are looking for**

You do not need to be a senior specialist. We are interested in someone with relevant practical experience, strong technical skills and the ability to develop toward independent responsibility.

We expect:

- strong **Python** programming skills;

- practical experience with **AI or machine learning**;

- experience with **remote sensing, GIS and LiDAR or point-cloud data**;

- relevant experience or understanding of the **forest sector and forestry applications**;

- ability to develop analytical work into repeatable and maintainable technical solutions;

- ability to work independently and solve complex technical problems; and

- professional proficiency in **English**.


Professional proficiency in Finnish is a clear advantage.

**Additional advantages**

Experience with one or more of the following is beneficial:

- deep learning, computer vision or advanced point-cloud processing;

- Azure or another cloud environment, Docker or related deployment technologies;

- spatial databases or geospatial software development;

- technical customer meetings and demonstrations; or

- other languages relevant to international work.


Occasional participation in customer visits, conferences or international project activities may be possible.

**What we offer**

You will join a small and growing team where your work has a direct influence on the technical solutions we develop.

The role offers opportunities to:

- work on real operational forestry problems;

- combine AI, software development, GIS and remote sensing;

- participate in Finnish and international projects;

- contribute to new digital forestry services; and

- take increasing technical responsibility as your experience develops.


**Location and working arrangements**

Our office is in **Joensuu**, and the possibility to work regularly from Joensuu is a clear advantage. Hybrid and remote working arrangements within Finland are possible.

The position can be **full-time**, but working hours can also be adapted for a suitable candidate who is completing studies.

For administrative reasons, we are currently looking for a person who is resident and able to work in Finland.

**How to apply**

Please send your **CV** and a short description of:

- your relevant experience;

- the types of AI, remote-sensing, GIS or software-development work you have done; and

- why you would like to join Forest Key.


Send your application to:

Alain Minguet Director of International Business +358 44 9025317 alain@forestkey.eu

For questions about the position, you may contact Alain by email or by phone during the following available periods:

- 28 August, 09:00–11:00

- 2 September, 14:00–17:00

- 4 September, 09:00–11:00


**Application deadline: 10 September 2026.**

We may fill the position before the application deadline if we find a suitable candidate, so early applications are encouraged.

Etsimämme henkilöt ovat osaavia, itsenäiseen työhön kykeneviä ja motivoituneita koneistajia, jotka haluavat päästä tekemään monipuolista konepajatyötä. Jonkin verran käytetään myös Fanukin järjestelmiä.

**Työt alkavat nopealla aikataululla heti sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä.** Työtä tehdään yhdessä vuorossa maanantaista perjantaihin ja aloitus on liukuvasti klo 6-7 välillä. Työpäivän pituus on 8,5h sisältäen palkattoman 30 minuutin ruokatauon. Onhan sinulla oma auto liikkumista varten.

Mitä työ pitää sisällään:

**Työtehtävät ovat monipuolisia ja niitä voidaan muokata osaamisesi ja kiinnostuksesi mukaan. Ensisijaisesti haemme CNC-koneistajaa, mutta myös kokenut manuaalikoneistaja on tervetullut hakemaan – CNC-koneistuksen osaamista voidaan tarvittaessa opettaa työn ohessa.**

- CNC-koneiden käyttö ja asetusten tekeminen

- manuaalikoneistus

- ohjelmointi ja ohjelmien muokkaaminen

- mittaukset ja laadunvalvonta

- teknisten piirustusten lukeminen

Toivomme sinulta:

- CNC- ja/tai manuaalikoneistuksen osaamista

- Kone- ja tuotantotekniikan perustutkinto on etu, mutta työkokemus ja osaaminen ovat etusijalla

- Kykyä työskennellä itsenäisesti

- Halua oppia uusia koneita ja työmenetelmiä

- Halua sitoutua pitkäaikaisesti työtehtäviin

- Omaa autoa


Tarjoamme:

jobs.title: Hoitaja sympaattiselle ruotsinkieliselle asiakkaalle Porvoossa
jobs.description:
Hoiva-avustaja sympaattiselle seniorille

Haemme hoiva-avustajaa osa-aikaiseen työhön avustamaan sympaattista ruotsinkielistä senioriasiakastamme Porvoossa. Etsimme myös hoitajaa avustamaan muita asiakkaitamme.

Haluaisitko tehdä hoiva-avustajan työtä osa-aikaisesti, kiireettömästi ja ilman sairaanhoidollisia työtehtäviä sympaattisten ikäihmisten kanssa? Saatat olet tuleva hoitaja-helpperimme! Olit sitten opiskelija, kerryttänyt jo kokemusta hoiva-avustajana tai etsit muuten vain osa-aikatyötä, tässä roolissa ratkaisee innokkuus ja aito halu auttaa suurella sydämellä!

Me olemme Hemby, ikääntyneiden palveluita rohkeasti uudistava yritys, joka tarjoaa iloa ja turvaa ikäihmisten arkeen. Mottomme on: autamme ikääntyviä kuin omaa äitiämme.

Kasvamme jatkuvasti ja etsimme lisää hoiva-avustajan koulutuksen omaavia helppereitä tiimiimme. Löydät lyhyen ja helposti täytettävän hakulomakkeemme täältä: https://helpper.hemby.fi/apply

Mitä hoitaja-helpperi tekee?

Hoitaja-helpperi on sosiaali- ja terveysalan koulutettu henkilö, joka tarjoaa arjen apua ja seuraa omalle nimetylle ikäihmiselle. Hoitaja-helpperi tukee ikäihmistä kaikenlaisissa arjen askareissa, kuten ulkoilu ja kauppareissut, kodin ylläpito, ruokailussa tukeminen, saattoapu, yhdessäolo ja jutustelu.

Hoitaja-helpperi tukee seniorin hyvinvointia kokonaisvaltaisesti. Hoivan ja huolenpidon tehtävät sisältävät:

suihkuapua voinnin tarkkailua kotona pärjäämisen tukemista liikkumisessa tukemista

Lisäksi voit auttaa asiakasta suihkussa ja henkilökohtaisessa hygieniassa. Työtehtäviin ei kuitenkaan kuulu sairaanhoidollisten palveluiden toteutusta, kuten lääkehoitoa.

Mitä hoitaja-helpperin työ vaatii?

Sitä, että palat halusta auttaa ikäihmisiä. Lisäksi hoitaja-helpperin työ vaatii sosiaali- ja terveysalan tai hoiva-avustajan koulutuksen tai vankan kokemuksen hoiva-avustajan työstä.

Tärkeintä on, että haluat viettää aikaa ikäihmisten kanssa ja tehdä omalla toiminnallasi heidän arjestaan parempaa. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat hyvin joustavat.

Mikä on parasta hoitaja-helpperin työssä?

Kysyimme tätä hoitaja-helppereiltämme, ja näin he vastasivat:

"Ihmisten kiireetön kohtaaminen ja ystävystyminen seniorin kanssa."

"Toisen auttaminen ja merkityksellisyyden tunne."

Auttaminen kokonaisvaltaisesti seniorin tarpeiden mukaan."

Hoitaja-helpperinä saat:

Oman nimetyn ikäihmisen, jota autat arjen askareissa ja olet hänelle seurana Joustavat työajat, jotka sopivat mainiosti esimerkiksi opiskelun ohelle tai lisätyöksi. Tavallisin työaika on 2-10h/vko. Kilpailukykyisen palkan: 15,29-17,29 €/h + työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät sekä lomakorvaukset. Hyvät etenemismahdollisuudet: Voit edetä kokemuksen ja hyvän asiakaspalautteen ansiosta pro- tai guru-helpperiksi ja saada korotusta palkkaasi!

Hakemukset lähetetään sähköisen lomakkeen kautta. Olemme kaikkiin hakijoihin yhteydessä hakemuksen lähettämisen jälkeen.

Lähetä hakemus hoitaja-helpperiksi täällä.

Lue lisää Hembystä klikkaamalla tästä.

Mikäli sinulla on kysyttävää hoitaja-helpperiksi ryhtymisestä, laita meille sähköpostia osoitteeseen rekry@hemby.fi, niin jutellaan lisää!

jobs.title: Barnehagelærer
jobs.description:
Vi lyser ut et vikariat som barnehagelærer med tiltredelse snarest og varighet til 18.06.27. Med mulighet for forlengelse.

Vi søker etter deg som er ambisiøs på vegne av barna, handlekraftig, omsetter teori til praksis, og som virkelig ønsker å skape en god barnehage til det beste for barnet og familien!  

Svanevågen søker Barnehagelærer vikariat – og kanskje er det deg?

Vi leter etter en trygg medarbeider som vet hvor stor forskjell én god relasjon kan gjøre. En som har hjertet på rett sted, hodet fullt av fag, og som drives av å gjøre barnas verden rikere – gjennom omsorg, utforsking og engasjement. Som vi sier i våre verdier: En som er kompetent og nyskapende med et stort hjerte til det beste for barnet.

Hva kan du forvente hos oss? Du får bli en del av et lag med høy faglig puls og et stort hjerte. Vi gir deg:

Et varmt og inkluderende kollegafellesskap

  • Veiledning og faglig utvikling fra første dag

  • Et arbeidsmiljø som tar forskning på alvor og setter kunnskap ut i livet

  • Nettverk med 3000 Norlandia

  • Kolleger over hele landet

  • Anstendig lønn og pensjon og eget fordelsprogram

  • Ekstra støtte til nyutdannede

  • En hverdag fylt med variasjon, lek og ekte øyeblikk

Vi tror du lykkes hos oss hvis du:

  • Brenner for å skape trygge relasjoner og god barndom

  • Liker å være tilgjengelig for barna, responsiv og deltakende

  • Villig til å omsette pedagogisk teori til praksis bygget på systematikk

  • Ser betydningen av kvalitet og omsetter observasjon og refleksjon over egen praksis til trening og handling

  • Støtter barns lek og læring med sensitivitet og varme

  • Bidrar til et alderstilpasset pedagogisk innhold med fokus på tidlig stimulering, lek og læring

  • Faglig engasjert, profesjonell og setter barnets beste først

Hvem er vi i Norlandia Barnehagene?

Vi er en barnehagekjede som tør å tenke nytt. Vi jobber systematisk med kvalitet, og bruker CLASS som verktøy for å styrke relasjonen mellom barn og voksne. Vi er kunnskapsdrevne, varme og opptatt av at alle barn – uansett bakgrunn – skal få en barndom preget av mestring, trygghet og glede.

Formelle kvalifikasjonskrav

• Treårig høgskoleutdanning som barnehagelærer eller annen treårig pedagogisk utdanning på høgskolenivå med videreutdanning i barnehagepedagogikk

• Godkjent utdanning fra Utdanningsdirektoratet.

• Utenlandske søkere må ha Bergenstest/B2 og godkjent utdanning fra Direktoratet for høyere utdanning og kompetanse - https://hkdir.no/utdanning-frautlandet

• Godkjent politiattest (ikke eldre enn 3 måneder) må vises ved tiltredelse (ref. barnehageloven §30)

Aktuelle kandidater vil bli intervjuet fortløpende, og vi gjør oppmerksom på at stillingen kan bli besatt før annonsen utløper.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

I Norlandia Barnehagene er vårt mål er at alle barn skal ha et likeverdig tilbud og gå i en høykvalitetsbarnehage. Nøkkelen til det er kompetente ansatte som er omsorgsfulle og utviklingsorienterte, derfor deler vi kunnskap med hverandre og er stolte av arbeidsplassen vår.

Vi baserer vårt arbeid på kunnskap og innovasjon, som omhandler at vår praksis utvikler seg i tråd med ny forskning og erfaring. God ledelse, felles kultur og standard, samt et rikt leke- og læringsmiljø er viktig for barna, og for oss.

Derfor har vi valgt ut noen felles satsningsområder som vi vet har stor betydning for barns utvikling og progresjon. Vi jobber helthetlig og systematisk med intern kompetanseutvikling og ekstern barnehagevurdering med blant annet CLASS som verktøy.

jobs.title: Mökkisiivooja
jobs.description:
Etsimme joukkoomme tulevalle talvisesongille 2026-2027 mökkisiivoojia. Tässä tehtävässä olet tärkeässä osassa asiakkaidemme kokemusta ja elämystä lomanaikana.

Työpäiväsi koostuvat monipuolisista siivouksista, siivouskohteita on mökeistä villoihin. Työ tehdään pareittain ja kohteet sijaitsevat Äkäslompolon alueella. Ajokortti on tarpeellinen, koska kohteisiin siirrytään yrityksen autoilla.

Työ on fyysistä ja sosiaalista sekä nopeatempoista, joten kyseiset ominaisuudet ja niihin sopeutuminen on isossa roolissa työtehtävässä.

Arvostamme paineensietokykyä, oma-aloitteisuutta, pysymistä aikatauluissa ja positiivista asennetta vaihtuviin tilanteisiin. Työkielet ovat suomi ja englanti, joten toisen tai jommankumman sujuva osaaminen on vaatimuksena.

Työsuhde on määräaikainen ja osa-aikainen, pääpaino on vaihtopäivissä , jotka sijoittuvat pääasiassa lauantaihin ja sunnuntaihin. Työ sopii lisätyöksi muun työn ohella, mutta vaatii sitoutumista sovittuihin työpäiviin.

Me tarjoamme sinulle kansainvälisen ja ihmisläheisen työympäristön, hyvän perehdytyksen, esihenkilöiden tuen ja hyvän tiimihengen, ja paljon uusia kokemuksia, näkemyksiä ja ikuisia ystäviä.

Palkka työkokemuksen mukaan sovittavissa.
